title: FAOPs: Normal Forms and an Algebra for AI Agent Workflows

paragraphs.en: Organizations increasingly encode operational procedures as multi-step agent skills , here called Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs), that must be traceable, auditable, reproducible, access-controlled, and bounded in time and cost, requirements that regulated sectors make mandatory. Yet AOPs are typically kept as coarse-grained files, in which steps bundle actions, copied procedures drift apart, any step may reach any tool, and refactoring goes unchecked. We present Functional Agent Operating Procedures (FAOP) , a formal theory that brings database-grade discipline to AI agent workflows. FAOP recasts each workflow as a typed function over scoped state and subjects an entire library to four progressive normal forms : Decomposed (FNF-1) splits a workflow into atomic steps, Typed (FNF-2) makes its data flow explicit and type-checked, Factored (FNF-3) gives each shared procedure a single canonical definition so a change propagates instead of drifting, and Scoped (FNF-4) confines every step to least-privilege tool access. Once normalized, every atomic step is a separate entity with a declared contract and can be type-checked, scope-confined, bounded, tested, traced, and audited on its own. A FAOP algebra of provably sound equalities turns refactoring and parallelization into compiler rewrites; orthogonal extensions add verified termination (+V), optimization (+O), and time and cost bounds (+B); and an architectural-level classifier (0–3) determines whether a workflow needs AI at all. Together, these make integrity, isolation, typing, termination, cost, and optimization compile-time concerns across the whole library, not runtime hopes. We implement the theory in SkillBase , an AOP management system (what PostgreSQL is to data, SkillBase is to AOPs), together with a separate executor that enforces these guarantees at run time. A worked financial workflow illustrates the approach end to end.
paragraphs.zh: 组织越来越多地将操作流程编码为多步骤智能体技能，此处称为智能体操作流程（AOP），这些流程必须可追溯、可审计、可重复执行、具备访问控制，并在时间和成本上受到限制，而这些要求已被受监管行业强制实施。 然而，AOP 通常以粗粒度文件的形式存在：其中各步骤将多个动作捆绑在一起，复制的流程会逐渐偏离原样，任何步骤都可能调用任意工具，且重构过程缺乏监督。 我们提出了功能智能体操作流程（FAOP），这是一种正式理论，为 AI 智能体的工作流程带来了数据库级别的严谨性。 FAOP 将每个工作流程重新定义为作用于限定状态上的带类型函数，并使整个流程库遵循四种渐进式范式：分解范式（FNF-1）将工作流程拆分为原子步骤；类型化范式（FNF-2）使其数据流显式且经过类型检查；因式分解范式（FNF-3）为每个共享流程定义唯一的规范定义，从而确保修改能统一传播而非逐渐偏离；作用域限定范式（FNF-4）则限制每个步骤仅使用最小权限的工具访问。 一旦完成范式化，每个原子步骤都成为一个独立的实体，具有明确的契约，并可单独进行类型检查、作用域限定、边界约束、测试、追踪和审计。 FAOP 的代数系统通过可证明正确的等式关系，将重构和并行化转化为编译器级别的改写；正交扩展则增加了经过验证的终止性（+V）、优化（+O）以及时间和成本限制（+B）；此外，一个架构级分类器（0–3）可判断某个工作流程是否真的需要 AI。 这些机制共同确保了完整性、隔离性、类型化、终止性、成本和优化等问题在整个流程库中成为编译时的关注点，而非运行时模糊的期望。 我们在 SkillBase 中实现了这一理论——这是一个 AOP 管理系统（正如 PostgreSQL 之于数据，SkillBase 之于 AOP），并配套一个独立的执行器，用于在运行时强制执行这些保障。 一个完整的金融工作流程实例展示了该方法从端到端的实现过程。

paragraphs.en: AI agents are entering the operational core of organizations, most visibly in regulated industries. A bank runs an agent to onboard a client through KYC, an insurer to investigate a claim for fraud, a hospital to secure prior authorization for a procedure, a law firm to review a contract for non-standard clauses, and so on. In each case a decision is acceptable only when the institution can show exactly how it was reached: which steps ran, in what order, on which data, under which permissions, and with what result, reproducibly and open to audit by a regulator. Any production agent workflow must therefore be traceable, auditable, reproducible, access-controlled, and bounded in time and cost; in regulated industries these are not optional qualities but conditions of deployment. None of them is supplied by the language model itself; each is a property of the multi-step workflow built around it.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能智能体正在进入组织的运营核心，在受监管行业中表现得尤为明显。 银行运行一个智能体来通过“了解你的客户”（KYC）流程引入新客户；保险公司运行一个智能体来调查理赔中的欺诈行为；医院运行一个智能体来获取医疗程序的预先批准；律师事务所运行一个智能体来审查合同中的非标准条款，等等。 在每种情况下，只有当机构能够准确展示决策过程时，该决策才可被接受：即哪些步骤被执行、执行顺序如何、基于哪些数据、在何种权限下执行，以及结果为何，并且这一过程必须可重复且接受监管机构的审计。 因此，任何生产环境中的智能体工作流程都必须具备可追溯性、可审计性、可重复性、访问控制性，并在时间和成本上受到限制；在受监管行业中，这些并非可选特性，而是部署的必要条件。 上述特性无一由语言模型本身提供；它们都是围绕该模型构建的多步骤工作流程所具备的属性。

paragraphs.en: The reusable unit of agent behavior is the skill : an artifact stored outside the model’s weights that tells an agent how to perform a task, and that can be versioned, retrieved, and executed without retraining [ 1 , 2 ] . Skills range from a single wrapped tool call to a composite procedure with its own control flow [ 1 ] . This paper concerns the composite, operational kind: the multi-step procedure an institution would otherwise write as a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for a person to follow. We call its agent-executable form an Agent Operating Procedure (AOP). 1 1 1 AOP denotes Agent Operating Procedure, unrelated to aspect-oriented programming. An AOP is thus a workflow-shaped skill, and its steps are themselves skills: primitive actions, or calls to other AOPs.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体行为的可重用单元是技能：一种存储在模型权重之外的产物，它告诉智能体如何执行任务，并且可以在无需重新训练的情况下进行版本管理、获取和执行 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 技能的范畴从单个封装的工具调用，到带有自身控制流的复合流程不等 [ 1 ] 。 本文关注的是复合且可操作的类型：即机构原本会作为标准作业程序（SOP）编写出来供人遵循的多步骤流程。 我们将智能体可执行的形式称为智能体作业程序（AOP）。1 1 1 AOP 表示智能体作业程序，与面向切面编程无关。 因此，AOP 是一种具有工作流结构的技能，其各个步骤本身也是技能：即基本操作或对其他 AOP 的调用。

sents.en: The reusable unit of agent behavior is the skill : an artifact stored outside the model’s weights that tells an agent how to perform a task, and that can be versioned, retrieved, and executed without retraining [ 1 , 2 ] .
sents.zh: 智能体行为的可重用单元是技能：一种存储在模型权重之外的产物，它告诉智能体如何执行任务，并且可以在无需重新训练的情况下进行版本管理、获取和执行 [ 1 , 2 ] 。

sents.zh: 我们将智能体可执行的形式称为智能体作业程序（AOP）。1 1 1 AOP 表示智能体作业程序，与面向切面编程无关。

sents.en: An AOP is thus a workflow-shaped skill, and its steps are themselves skills: primitive actions, or calls to other AOPs.
sents.zh: 因此，AOP 是一种具有工作流结构的技能，其各个步骤本身也是技能：即基本操作或对其他 AOP 的调用。

paragraphs.en: The name and description make it discoverable; the inputs and outputs type its interface; the body holds the ordered steps.
paragraphs.zh: 名称和描述使其可被发现；输入和输出定义了其接口；主体包含按顺序排列的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Because an AOP lives outside the model’s weights, proprietary procedures stay confidential rather than baked into external weights, a procedure survives model upgrades and provider changes, and shared sub-procedures are reused across workflows rather than reimplemented. These properties are why organizations build libraries of reusable AOPs that agents draw on at runtime, increasingly populated not only by hand but by generators that emit many from natural-language descriptions or existing operational knowledge (Section 6.2 ). How an AOP is discovered, retrieved, or activated over such a library is a separate lifecycle concern we do not address [ 3 ] ; our subject is the body: its structure, its composition, and the guarantees a compiler can establish over it before the workflow runs.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 AOP 存在于模型权重之外，专有流程得以保持机密，而非被嵌入外部权重中；因此，流程在模型升级和提供商变更时仍能保留，且共享的子流程可在不同工作流中重复使用，而无需重新实现。 正是这些特性促使组织构建可重用的 AOP 库，供智能体在运行时调用。这类库的内容不仅越来越多地由人工添加，也通过生成器自动创建——生成器可根据自然语言描述或现有操作知识批量生成多个 AOP（第 6.2 节）。 智能体如何从这样的库中查找、获取或激活某个 AOP，属于独立的生命周期问题，本文不予讨论 [3]；我们的研究重点是 AOP 本身：其结构、组成，以及编译器在工作流运行前能够为其建立的保障。

paragraphs.en: The high-level architecture is simple (Figure 1 ). A single generic agent executor (commonly a loop of reason, act, and observe [ 4 ] , though the exact implementation varies by team) takes two inputs that change per workflow: an AOP describing the steps, and a list of tools the agent may call. A deployed system usually adds a user or agent interface and a gateway that mediates access to external agents and tools. The executor itself does not change: to deploy a new workflow, one writes a new AOP and configures a new tool list, and the same agent code runs onboarding, compliance checks, payment processing, and more. This separation of what from how is also what makes development fast: because the executor is fixed and runs any AOP, shipping a new agent collapses to authoring one AOP, with no bespoke orchestration code to write, test, or deploy.
paragraphs.zh: 高层架构非常简单（图 1）。 一个通用的智能体执行器（通常是一个包含推理、行动和观察的循环 [4]，尽管具体实现因团队而异）接收两个随工作流程变化的输入：描述步骤的 AOP，以及智能体可调用的工具列表。 部署的系统通常会增加用户或智能体界面，以及一个用于协调对外部智能体和工具访问的网关。 执行器本身不会改变：要部署新的工作流程，只需编写新的 AOP 并配置新的工具列表，而相同的智能体代码即可处理入职、合规检查、支付处理等任务。 这种“做什么”与“如何做”的分离也加快了开发速度：由于执行器是固定的且能运行任何 AOP，因此发布新智能体的过程简化为编写一个 AOP，无需编写、测试或部署任何定制化的编排代码。

sents.zh: 高层架构非常简单（图 1）。

sents.en: The executor itself does not change: to deploy a new workflow, one writes a new AOP and configures a new tool list, and the same agent code runs onboarding, compliance checks, payment processing, and more.
sents.zh: 执行器本身不会改变：要部署新的工作流程，只需编写新的 AOP 并配置新的工具列表，而相同的智能体代码即可处理入职、合规检查、支付处理等任务。

sents.en: This separation of what from how is also what makes development fast: because the executor is fixed and runs any AOP, shipping a new agent collapses to authoring one AOP, with no bespoke orchestration code to write, test, or deploy.
sents.zh: 这种“做什么”与“如何做”的分离也加快了开发速度：由于执行器是固定的且能运行任何 AOP，因此发布新智能体的过程简化为编写一个 AOP，无需编写、测试或部署任何定制化的编排代码。

paragraphs.en: This design works in the small but strains at scale. A bank may run thousands of AOPs that share sub-procedures (client lookup, compliance checks, document validation) copy-pasted as text, so a single change such as a new compliance rule must be re-applied by hand in many places while the copies drift silently and nothing records which AOP depends on which. Access control is often equally unstructured: tools are commonly granted to the AOP as a whole rather than to individual steps, so a single prompt injection can reach any of them, and the only “boundary” is a comment the model may or may not honor.
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计在小规模下可行，但在大规模下则会不堪重负。 一家银行可能运行数千个 AOP，这些 AOP 共享子程序（客户端查找、合规检查、文档验证），而这些子程序是以文本形式复制粘贴的。因此，一旦有单一变更（例如新增一条合规规则），就必须手动在许多地方重新应用该变更，而各个副本却在悄无声息中产生差异，且没有任何记录表明哪个 AOP 依赖于哪个副本。 访问控制通常同样缺乏结构化：工具通常是授予整个 AOP 而非单个步骤的，因此一次提示注入就可能触及其中的任何步骤，而唯一的“边界”只是一个模型可能遵守也可能不遵守的注释。

sents.en: This design works in the small but strains at scale.
sents.zh: 这种设计在小规模下可行，但在大规模下则会不堪重负。

sents.en: A bank may run thousands of AOPs that share sub-procedures (client lookup, compliance checks, document validation) copy-pasted as text, so a single change such as a new compliance rule must be re-applied by hand in many places while the copies drift silently and nothing records which AOP depends on which.
sents.zh: 一家银行可能运行数千个 AOP，这些 AOP 共享子程序（客户端查找、合规检查、文档验证），而这些子程序是以文本形式复制粘贴的。因此，一旦有单一变更（例如新增一条合规规则），就必须手动在许多地方重新应用该变更，而各个副本却在悄无声息中产生差异，且没有任何记录表明哪个 AOP 依赖于哪个副本。

sents.en: Access control is often equally unstructured: tools are commonly granted to the AOP as a whole rather than to individual steps, so a single prompt injection can reach any of them, and the only “boundary” is a comment the model may or may not honor.
sents.zh: 访问控制通常同样缺乏结构化：工具通常是授予整个 AOP 而非单个步骤的，因此一次提示注入就可能触及其中的任何步骤，而唯一的“边界”只是一个模型可能遵守也可能不遵守的注释。

paragraphs.en: These failures are symptoms of one structural fault: an AOP is treated as an opaque monolith (authored, tested, deployed, observed, and governed as one indivisible unit), so nothing below the whole workflow can be reused, type-checked, tested, scoped, or traced on its own. From this fault follow the defects an AOP library accrues as it grows from a handful of workflows into a governed catalog of thousands, the problem this paper addresses:
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败现象都源于一个结构性问题：AOP 被当作一个不透明的整体（即被视为一个不可分割的单元进行编写、测试、部署、观察和管理），因此整个工作流之下的任何部分都无法单独被重用、类型检查、测试、限定作用域或追踪。 由此问题衍生出 AOP 库在成长过程中积累的一系列缺陷——当它从最初仅有少数几个工作流，逐渐扩展为包含数千个工作流的受管理目录时，这些问题便愈发显著，而这正是本文要解决的问题：

sents.en: These failures are symptoms of one structural fault: an AOP is treated as an opaque monolith (authored, tested, deployed, observed, and governed as one indivisible unit), so nothing below the whole workflow can be reused, type-checked, tested, scoped, or traced on its own.
sents.zh: 这些失败现象都源于一个结构性问题：AOP 被当作一个不透明的整体（即被视为一个不可分割的单元进行编写、测试、部署、观察和管理），因此整个工作流之下的任何部分都无法单独被重用、类型检查、测试、限定作用域或追踪。

sents.en: From this fault follow the defects an AOP library accrues as it grows from a handful of workflows into a governed catalog of thousands, the problem this paper addresses:
sents.zh: 由此问题衍生出 AOP 库在成长过程中积累的一系列缺陷——当它从最初仅有少数几个工作流，逐渐扩展为包含数千个工作流的受管理目录时，这些问题便愈发显著，而这正是本文要解决的问题：

paragraphs.en: Integrity across the library. Shared sub-procedures are copy-pasted and drift out of sync; inter-AOP dependencies are invisible, so a change breaks dependents without warning; agent-to-agent calls can form unbounded cycles; and with no shared vocabulary ( client_id versus id_client ) nothing composes.
paragraphs.zh: 整个库中保持一致性。 共享的子程序被复制粘贴后逐渐不同步；AOP 之间的依赖关系不可见，因此一次更改会毫无预警地破坏依赖项；智能体之间的调用可能形成无界的循环；而且由于没有共享的词汇表（client_id 与 id_client），任何组件都无法组合。

sents.en: Integrity across the library.
sents.zh: 整个库中保持一致性。

sents.en: Shared sub-procedures are copy-pasted and drift out of sync; inter-AOP dependencies are invisible, so a change breaks dependents without warning; agent-to-agent calls can form unbounded cycles; and with no shared vocabulary ( client_id versus id_client ) nothing composes.
sents.zh: 共享的子程序被复制粘贴后逐渐不同步；AOP 之间的依赖关系不可见，因此一次更改会毫无预警地破坏依赖项；智能体之间的调用可能形成无界的循环；而且由于没有共享的词汇表（client_id 与 id_client），任何组件都无法组合。

paragraphs.en: Correctness within a workflow. State is often untyped, so a step can read a field no earlier step produced; loops may run unbounded and branches may be dead (unreachable); and no time or cost bound is declared or checked.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流中的正确性。 状态通常没有类型，因此一个步骤可以读取前一个步骤未生成的字段；循环可能无限运行，分支可能无效（无法到达）；并且没有声明或检查时间或成本限制。

sents.en: Correctness within a workflow.
sents.zh: 工作流中的正确性。

sents.en: State is often untyped, so a step can read a field no earlier step produced; loops may run unbounded and branches may be dead (unreachable); and no time or cost bound is declared or checked.
sents.zh: 状态通常没有类型，因此一个步骤可以读取前一个步骤未生成的字段；循环可能无限运行，分支可能无效（无法到达）；并且没有声明或检查时间或成本限制。

paragraphs.en: Isolation. Steps are rarely confined to the tools and data they need, so the blast radius of a single compromised step can be the entire AOP.
paragraphs.zh: 孤立性。 各个步骤很少局限于所需工具和数据的范围，因此单个受侵害步骤的影响范围可能波及整个 AOP。

sents.en: Isolation.
sents.zh: 孤立性。

sents.en: Steps are rarely confined to the tools and data they need, so the blast radius of a single compromised step can be the entire AOP.
sents.zh: 各个步骤很少局限于所需工具和数据的范围，因此单个受侵害步骤的影响范围可能波及整个 AOP。

paragraphs.en: Composition and governance. Existing algebras for composing LLM steps establish only identity and associativity [ 5 , 6 ] , so none has a law that reorders a sequence of independent steps or runs them in parallel; and the choice between no AI, an LLM as a tool, and a planner is made with no formal basis.
paragraphs.zh: 组合与治理。 现有用于组合 LLM 步骤的代数仅确立了单位元和结合律 [5, 6]，因此没有任何一种代数具备能够重排独立步骤序列或并行执行这些步骤的规则；此外，在“不使用 AI”“将 LLM 作为工具使用”以及“使用规划器”这三种选择之间，也缺乏正式的依据来做出决策。

sents.en: Composition and governance.
sents.zh: 组合与治理。

sents.en: Existing algebras for composing LLM steps establish only identity and associativity [ 5 , 6 ] , so none has a law that reorders a sequence of independent steps or runs them in parallel; and the choice between no AI, an LLM as a tool, and a planner is made with no formal basis.
sents.zh: 现有用于组合 LLM 步骤的代数仅确立了单位元和结合律 [5, 6]，因此没有任何一种代数具备能够重排独立步骤序列或并行执行这些步骤的规则；此外，在“不使用 AI”“将 LLM 作为工具使用”以及“使用规划器”这三种选择之间，也缺乏正式的依据来做出决策。

paragraphs.en: These failures are already documented at scale: a data-driven study of 40,285 published skills reports widespread intent-level redundancy and skills that take unscoped state-changing or system-level actions [ 7 ] , a recent survey reports that 26.1% of community-contributed skills contain vulnerabilities [ 8 ] , and loading skills is itself shown to induce hundreds of task failures and efficiency regressions [ 9 ] . Normalization breaks the monolith into typed, independently checkable steps (each reused, tested, bounded, scoped, and observed in isolation), which is what turns every defect above into an enforceable guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败现象已有大规模记录：一项基于数据的、对 40,285 份已发布技能报告的研究揭示了广泛的意图层级冗余，以及那些未经界定地改变状态或执行系统级操作的技能 [7]；最近的一项调查显示，26.1% 由社区贡献的技能存在漏洞 [8]；而且已有证据表明，加载技能本身就会导致数百次任务失败和效率下降 [9]。 规范化将整体结构分解为带有类型、可独立验证的步骤（每个步骤均可单独复用、测试、限定范围、界定作用域并受观察），而这正是将上述所有缺陷转化为可强制执行保障的关键。

sents.en: These failures are already documented at scale: a data-driven study of 40,285 published skills reports widespread intent-level redundancy and skills that take unscoped state-changing or system-level actions [ 7 ] , a recent survey reports that 26.1% of community-contributed skills contain vulnerabilities [ 8 ] , and loading skills is itself shown to induce hundreds of task failures and efficiency regressions [ 9 ] .
sents.zh: 这些失败现象已有大规模记录：一项基于数据的、对 40,285 份已发布技能报告的研究揭示了广泛的意图层级冗余，以及那些未经界定地改变状态或执行系统级操作的技能 [7]；最近的一项调查显示，26.1% 由社区贡献的技能存在漏洞 [8]；而且已有证据表明，加载技能本身就会导致数百次任务失败和效率下降 [9]。

sents.en: Normalization breaks the monolith into typed, independently checkable steps (each reused, tested, bounded, scoped, and observed in isolation), which is what turns every defect above into an enforceable guarantee.
sents.zh: 规范化将整体结构分解为带有类型、可独立验证的步骤（每个步骤均可单独复用、测试、限定范围、界定作用域并受观察），而这正是将上述所有缺陷转化为可强制执行保障的关键。

paragraphs.en: This paper gives AOPs that discipline. We introduce FAOPs : each workflow recast as a typed function over scoped state, normalized through four progressive normal forms and a companion algebra of provably sound equalities, so that integrity, isolation, typing, termination, cost, and optimization become compile-time concerns across the whole library, not runtime hopes.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了具有约束力的 AOPs。 我们引入了 FAOPs：每个工作流都被重构为作用于限定状态上的带类型函数，并通过四种渐进式规范形式以及配套的、可证明正确的等式代数进行规范化，从而使得完整性、隔离性、类型检查、终止性、成本与优化等问题成为整个库在编译时的关注点，而非运行时的期望。

sents.en: This paper gives AOPs that discipline.
sents.zh: 本文提出了具有约束力的 AOPs。

sents.en: We introduce FAOPs : each workflow recast as a typed function over scoped state, normalized through four progressive normal forms and a companion algebra of provably sound equalities, so that integrity, isolation, typing, termination, cost, and optimization become compile-time concerns across the whole library, not runtime hopes.
sents.zh: 我们引入了 FAOPs：每个工作流都被重构为作用于限定状态上的带类型函数，并通过四种渐进式规范形式以及配套的、可证明正确的等式代数进行规范化，从而使得完整性、隔离性、类型检查、终止性、成本与优化等问题成为整个库在编译时的关注点，而非运行时的期望。

paragraphs.en: AOP libraries are not the first to fail this way. Before Codd [ 10 ] , data lived in flat files in which every row repeated everything (Table 1 ). Such files had four structural defects: redundancy (Alice’s address and branch manager repeat on every row), broken integrity (update one row, miss another, and the file contradicts itself), uncontrolled access (anyone who reads the file reads everything), and no optimization (every query scans every row). The answer, begun by Codd, was not a better file but a theory : normal forms, a relational algebra, and schemas that enforce integrity and access by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 采用这种失败方式的并非首个 AOP 库。 在 Codd [ 10 ] 之前，数据以平面文件的形式存在，其中每一行都重复了所有信息（表 1）。 这类文件存在四个结构性缺陷：冗余性（爱丽丝的地址和分行经理信息在每一行都会重复）、完整性缺失（更新一行时可能遗漏另一行，导致文件自相矛盾）、访问失控（任何读取该文件的人都能获取全部信息），以及缺乏优化（每次查询都需要扫描所有行）。 Codd 提出的解决方案并非一种更优的文件形式，而是一种理论：范式、关系代数，以及通过其结构本身来强制实施完整性和访问控制的模式。

sents.en: AOP libraries are not the first to fail this way.
sents.zh: 采用这种失败方式的并非首个 AOP 库。

sents.en: Before Codd [ 10 ] , data lived in flat files in which every row repeated everything (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 在 Codd [ 10 ] 之前，数据以平面文件的形式存在，其中每一行都重复了所有信息（表 1）。

sents.en: Such files had four structural defects: redundancy (Alice’s address and branch manager repeat on every row), broken integrity (update one row, miss another, and the file contradicts itself), uncontrolled access (anyone who reads the file reads everything), and no optimization (every query scans every row).
sents.zh: 这类文件存在四个结构性缺陷：冗余性（爱丽丝的地址和分行经理信息在每一行都会重复）、完整性缺失（更新一行时可能遗漏另一行，导致文件自相矛盾）、访问失控（任何读取该文件的人都能获取全部信息），以及缺乏优化（每次查询都需要扫描所有行）。

sents.en: The answer, begun by Codd, was not a better file but a theory : normal forms, a relational algebra, and schemas that enforce integrity and access by construction.
sents.zh: Codd 提出的解决方案并非一种更优的文件形式，而是一种理论：范式、关系代数，以及通过其结构本身来强制实施完整性和访问控制的模式。

paragraphs.en: An AOP library is typically prone to the same four defects: procedures are copied, copies drift apart, any step may reach any tool, and refactoring goes unchecked. FAOP gives it the same three answers (normal forms, an algebra, and typed, scoped contracts in place of schemas) and the same new role: the Skill Architect , who designs, normalizes, and governs an organization’s AOP library, the DBA of the agentic era.
paragraphs.zh: AOP 库通常容易受到相同的四种缺陷：程序被复制，副本逐渐偏离，任何步骤都可能调用任何工具，以及重构过程缺乏检查。 FAOP 提供了相同的三个答案（范式、代数结构，以及用类型化和作用域明确的契约替代模式），并引入了一个新的角色：技能架构师，负责设计、规范和管理组织的 AOP 库，堪称智能体时代的 DBA。

sents.en: An AOP library is typically prone to the same four defects: procedures are copied, copies drift apart, any step may reach any tool, and refactoring goes unchecked.
sents.zh: AOP 库通常容易受到相同的四种缺陷：程序被复制，副本逐渐偏离，任何步骤都可能调用任何工具，以及重构过程缺乏检查。

sents.en: FAOP gives it the same three answers (normal forms, an algebra, and typed, scoped contracts in place of schemas) and the same new role: the Skill Architect , who designs, normalizes, and governs an organization’s AOP library, the DBA of the agentic era.
sents.zh: FAOP 提供了相同的三个答案（范式、代数结构，以及用类型化和作用域明确的契约替代模式），并引入了一个新的角色：技能架构师，负责设计、规范和管理组织的 AOP 库，堪称智能体时代的 DBA。

paragraphs.en: A formal definition of FAOPs as typed, composable functions over scoped state, with explicit scope boundaries per step (Section 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: FAOPs 的正式定义是：作为基于作用域状态的、具有类型且可组合的智能体函数，每一步都具有明确的作用域边界（第 2 节）。

paragraphs.en: A FAOP algebra with equational laws (commutativity of independent steps, associativity of sequential composition, branch distribution, and fold/unfold) that enable meaning-preserving refactoring and automatic parallelization of independent steps (Section 3.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种具有等式定律（独立步骤的交换性、顺序组合的结合性、分支分配以及折叠/展开）的 FAOP 代数，这些定律支持保留语义的重构以及对独立步骤的自动并行化（第 3.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Four progressive normal forms (FNF-1 through FNF-4) that incrementally guarantee atomicity, type safety, composition without duplication over an acyclic call graph that removes the recursion anomaly (a workflow that silently calls itself and never terminates), and compile-time scope confinement, whereby each step declares the tools it may use and the compiler rejects any step that exceeds its parent’s permissions, so privilege escalation through composition is caught before deployment; the SOP/AOP/skill-to-FAOP translation is realized as FNF-1’s first activity (Section 3 ). Additional behavioral properties, namely verified termination and reachability (+V), semantics-preserving optimization such as parallelization (+O), and time and cost bounds (+B), are formalized as orthogonal extensions on top of the four normal forms.
paragraphs.zh: 四种渐进式正常形式（FNF-1 至 FNF-4）逐步确保了原子性、类型安全性、在消除递归异常（一种静默调用自身且永不终止的工作流）的无环调用图上实现的无重复组合，以及编译时的作用域限制：每一步都会声明其可使用的工具，编译器会拒绝任何超出其父步骤权限的步骤，从而在部署前就发现通过组合导致的权限提升问题；SOP/AOP/技能到 FAOP 的转换则作为 FNF-1 的首个活动得以实现（第 3 节）。 其他行为特性，即经过验证的终止性和可达性（+V）、保持语义的优化（如并行化）（+O），以及时间和成本界限（+B），被形式化为在四种正常形式之上的正交扩展。

sents.en: Four progressive normal forms (FNF-1 through FNF-4) that incrementally guarantee atomicity, type safety, composition without duplication over an acyclic call graph that removes the recursion anomaly (a workflow that silently calls itself and never terminates), and compile-time scope confinement, whereby each step declares the tools it may use and the compiler rejects any step that exceeds its parent’s permissions, so privilege escalation through composition is caught before deployment; the SOP/AOP/skill-to-FAOP translation is realized as FNF-1’s first activity (Section 3 ).
sents.zh: 四种渐进式正常形式（FNF-1 至 FNF-4）逐步确保了原子性、类型安全性、在消除递归异常（一种静默调用自身且永不终止的工作流）的无环调用图上实现的无重复组合，以及编译时的作用域限制：每一步都会声明其可使用的工具，编译器会拒绝任何超出其父步骤权限的步骤，从而在部署前就发现通过组合导致的权限提升问题；SOP/AOP/技能到 FAOP 的转换则作为 FNF-1 的首个活动得以实现（第 3 节）。

sents.en: Additional behavioral properties, namely verified termination and reachability (+V), semantics-preserving optimization such as parallelization (+O), and time and cost bounds (+B), are formalized as orthogonal extensions on top of the four normal forms.
sents.zh: 其他行为特性，即经过验证的终止性和可达性（+V）、保持语义的优化（如并行化）（+O），以及时间和成本界限（+B），被形式化为在四种正常形式之上的正交扩展。

paragraphs.en: A compilation pipeline and registry: the compiler checks structural errors (dead states, type mismatches, scope violations, unreachable branches, and cyclic dependencies) before any runtime artifact is generated, and the registry’s impact analysis names every dependent workflow when a shared AOP changes, eliminating silent breakage (Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 编译流程与注册表：在生成任何运行时产物之前，编译器会检查结构性错误（死状态、类型不匹配、作用域违规、不可达分支和循环依赖），而注册表的影响分析会在共享 AOP 变更时明确列出所有依赖的工作流，从而避免静默故障（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: SkillBase, a reference implementation of an AOP management system (a vocabulary, compiler, and registry) that compiles a normalized AOP into an executable blueprint for the FAOP executor (Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: SkillBase 是一个面向切面编程（AOP）管理系统的参考实现（包括一个词汇表、编译器和注册表），它能够将规范化的 AOP 编译为 FAOP 执行器可执行的蓝图（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: An architectural-level classification (Level 0–3) computed from the normalized body, distinguishing a deterministic workflow, an LLM-as-tool agent, and selector/generator planners, giving organizations a formal basis for deciding whether a use case needs AI and how it must be governed (Section 3.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种基于架构层面的分类（等级 0–3），通过归一化主体计算得出，用以区分确定性工作流程、将 LLM 作为工具的智能体，以及选择器/生成器规划器，从而为组织提供一个正式的依据，以判断某一用例是否需要 AI 以及应如何对其进行治理（第 3.7 节）。

paragraphs.en: FAOP is to AOPs what relational theory is to data, and SkillBase is to an AOP library what PostgreSQL is to spreadsheets: the theory stands alone and can be applied by hand, but the tooling makes it practical at scale.
paragraphs.zh: FAOP 之于 AOP，正如关系理论之于数据；SkillBase 之于 AOP 库，正如 PostgreSQL 之于电子表格：理论本身独立存在且可以手动应用，但工具使其能够大规模实用化。

paragraphs.en: This section gives the formal definition of FAOPs, the primitive operators they are built from, and how those primitives combine into composite FAOPs.
paragraphs.zh: 本节给出了 FAOPs 的正式定义、构成它们的原始算子，以及这些原始算子如何组合成复合 FAOPs。

paragraphs.en: Let 𝒱 \mathcal{V} be a fixed vocabulary of typed field names. A state S S is a finite map from a subset of 𝒱 \mathcal{V} to typed values; we write S ⊆ S ′ S\subseteq S^{\prime} when every field of S S occurs in S ′ S^{\prime} with the same type.
paragraphs.zh: 令 𝒱 \mathcal{V} 为一个固定的带类型字段名的词汇表。 状态 S S 是一个从 𝒱 \mathcal{V} 的子集到带类型值的有限映射；当 S S 中的每个字段都出现在 S ′ S^{\prime} 中且具有相同的类型时，我们记作 S ⊆ S ′ S\subseteq S^{\prime}。

paragraphs.en: A Functional Agent Operating Procedure is a 5-tuple
paragraphs.zh: 功能性智能体操作程序是一个五元组

paragraphs.en: where id is a unique versioned registry key; n n and d d are a human-readable name and a semantic description used for discovery; b b is the body , a term in the grammar of Section 2.3 from which the typed function f : S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( F ) → S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 ​ ( F ) f:S_{\mathit{in}}(F)\to S_{\mathit{out}}(F) is derived by Convention 1 ; and Σ \Sigma is the scope , the tools F F may use and the guardrails it must enforce (Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 其中，id 是一个具有唯一版本标识的注册表键；n n 和 d d 分别是用于发现的易读名称和语义描述；b b 是主体，即第 2.3 节语法中的一个术语，根据约定 1，可从中推导出带类型的函数 f : S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( F ) → S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 ​ ( F ) f:S_{\mathit{in}}(F)\to S_{\mathit{out}}(F)；而 Σ \Sigma 是作用域，即智能体 F F 可以使用的工具以及其必须执行的约束（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: The workflow carries a state : a record mapping field names to values, threaded through the steps as in a functional program: each step reads the fields it needs and adds the fields it produces, then passes the updated record on. Crucially, every FAOP runs in its own scope, like a function call: it sees only the fields its caller passes in ( S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}} ) together with the local fields it computes itself, never another FAOP’s internals, and it returns to the caller only its declared outputs ( S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} ). If two steps in the same body write the same field, the later one wins; we write S ⊎ S ′ S\uplus S^{\prime} for this update.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流携带一个状态：一份将字段名映射到值的记录，该记录贯穿各个步骤，如同函数式程序一般：每个步骤读取其所需的字段并添加其生成的字段，然后将更新后的记录传递下去。 关键在于，每个 FAOP 都在自己的作用域中运行，类似于函数调用：它只能看到调用者传入的字段（S_{\mathit{in}}）以及自身计算出的局部字段，而永远无法访问其他 FAOP 的内部信息；它仅向调用者返回其声明的输出（S_{\mathit{out}}）。 如果同一主体中的两个步骤写入相同的字段，则以较晚的那个为准；我们用 S ⊎ S ′（S\uplus S^{\prime}）来表示这种更新。

paragraphs.en: Each step reads its inputs from the running record, with FNF-2 (Section 3.2 ) checking those fields are present; a faithful executor realizes each invocation as a function-call scope (a fresh frame per call, its locals discarded on return), so the later-write-wins update of ⊎ \uplus occurs only between steps of the same body, never across a call boundary or between concurrent siblings.
paragraphs.zh: 每一步都从运行记录中读取其输入，其中 FNF-2（第 3.2 节）会检查这些字段是否存在；一个忠实的执行器会将每次调用实现为一个函数调用作用域（每次调用创建一个新帧，返回时丢弃其局部变量），因此 ⊎ \uplus 的“后写优先”更新仅发生在同一主体的不同步骤之间，绝不会跨越调用边界或发生在并发兄弟进程之间。

paragraphs.en: A FAOP is a leaf when its body has no sub-bodies (an action a a , interrupt ι \iota , checkpoint χ \chi , or call 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) ), and a composite when its body is a 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} , 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} , or 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} combining sub-bodies. Each 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) resolves, in the ambient registry ℛ \mathcal{R} , to the body of ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] .
paragraphs.zh: 当一个 FAOP 的主体不包含任何子主体（即动作 a、中断 ι \iota、检查点 χ \chi，或调用 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id})）时，它是一个叶子；而当其主体是一个 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq}、𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 或 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop}，用于组合子主体时，它就是一个复合体。 每个 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) 都会在环境注册表 ℛ \mathcal{R} 中解析为 ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] 的主体。

paragraphs.en: The grammar and registry give rise to four graphs the paper keeps strictly separate. Three are structural: the body tree is one FAOP’s abstract syntax tree (internal nodes 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} , 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} , 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} ; leaves a a , ι \iota , χ \chi , or 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) ), finite and acyclic by construction; the execution graph is a single runtime trace, in which cycles arise only from 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} and termination is governed by the loop predicate; and the call graph below is the one later sections depend on. A fourth, the data-dependence graph , is not given by the grammar but derived from the FNF-2 schemas, and is introduced with the algebra for optimization analysis (Convention 3 , Section 3.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 语法规则和注册表共同生成了四个图，论文中始终严格区分这四个图。 其中三个是结构性的：主体树是某个 FAOP 的抽象语法树（内部节点为 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq}、𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if}、𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop}；叶子节点为 a a、ι \iota、χ \chi 或 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id})），根据构造本身有限且无环；执行图是一条单一的运行时轨迹，其中的循环仅由 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 产生，而终止则由循环谓词决定；下方的调用图则是后续章节所依赖的图。 第四个图——数据依赖图——并非由语法规则直接给出，而是从 FNF-2 模式推导得出，并在用于优化分析的代数体系（约定 3，第 3.5 节）中被引入。

paragraphs.en: Nodes are registered FAOPs, not AST nodes. An edge F → F ′ F\to F^{\prime} exists whenever b ⁡ ( F ) b(F) contains 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ​ ( id ​ ( F ′ ) ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}(F^{\prime})) at any depth; a shared sub-FAOP has several in-edges. Cycles are forbidden, so the call graph is a directed acyclic graph: a cyclic registry would block topological compilation, type-checking, and impact analysis (Section 4 ). Why this acyclicity also rules out silently non-terminating recursion is taken up in FNF-3 (Section 3.3 ) and +V (Section 3.6.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Inlining a 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) (substituting the callee’s body, which the acyclic call graph makes possible) is a semantic rewrite that preserves the callee’s scope (Convention 1 ): each call site gets its own copy with its own locals, and a fully inlined body is a finite tree of primitives equal in meaning to the original.
paragraphs.zh: 将 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) 内联（即替换被调用体的内容，而无环调用图使得这一操作成为可能）是一种语义重写，它保留了被调用体的作用域（约定 1）：每个调用位置都会获得一个带有自身局部变量的独立副本，而完全内联后的体则是一个由基本操作构成的有限树，其含义与原代码相同。

paragraphs.en: Because ℛ \mathcal{R} resolves each identifier to exactly one body, 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) and ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] are interchangeable at any position without changing S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}} , S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} , or behavior. We rely on this throughout to justify inlining, extraction, and the algebraic rewrites of Section 3.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于 ℛ \mathcal{R} 将每个标识符解析为且仅为一个主体，因此 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) 和 ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] 在任何位置都可以相互替换，而不会改变 S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}}、S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} 或行为。 我们在整个过程中都依赖这一点，以证明内联、提取以及第 3.5 节中的代数重写是合理的。

paragraphs.en: The grammar is expressive enough to encode any workflow: by the structured program theorem of Böhm and Jacopini [ 11 ] , sequence, selection, and iteration over atomic actions (which FAOP provides as 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} , 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} , 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} , and the action a a ) express any control flow drawable as a flowchart. The remaining primitives extend this core rather than narrow it: ι \iota adds external suspension and resumption for human or agent input, χ \chi adds state persistence, and each 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) abbreviates a registered body. None of these restricts the class of expressible workflows, so completeness still holds.
paragraphs.zh: 该语法具有足够的表达能力，可以编码任何工作流程：根据 Böhm 和 Jacopini 的结构化程序定理 [11]，序列、选择和迭代等基本操作（FAOP 分别通过 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq}、𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if}、𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 以及动作 a 来实现）能够表达任何可以绘制为流程图的控制流。 其余的基础操作是对这一核心功能的扩展，而非限制：ι \iota 增加了用于人类或智能体输入的外部暂停与恢复功能，χ \chi 增加了状态持久性，而每个 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) 都代表一个已注册的主体。 这些操作中的任何一项都不会限制可表达的工作流程类型，因此完整性仍然成立。

sents.zh: 这些操作中的任何一项都不会限制可表达的工作流程类型，因此完整性仍然成立。

paragraphs.en: Normalization reshapes a workflow library without changing the work it denotes. By normalization we mean transforming a workflow from one form into an equivalent one that resolves a specific class of anomaly. Its input is the firm’s whole library of source artifacts (Standard Operating Procedures, Agent Operating Procedures, or framework skills), typically many interconnected workflows that share steps, call one another, and evolve independently. Each is usually written as prose or thin pseudo-code for an LLM to follow, and the output is a registry of typed, composable FAOPs that a compiler can check. The four normal forms apply in order, and each is named for the anomaly it removes, just as each relational normal form is named for an update, insertion, or deletion anomaly it rules out:
paragraphs.zh: 规范化会重塑工作流库，但不会改变其所代表的工作内容。 我们所说的规范化，是指将一种形式的工作流转换为另一种等效的形式，从而解决某一特定类型的异常。 其输入是公司的全部源工件库（标准作业程序、智能体作业程序或框架技能），通常包含许多相互关联的工作流，这些工作流共享步骤、相互调用，并独立演化。 每个工件通常以散文形式或简洁的伪代码编写，供大型语言模型遵循；其输出则是一个经过类型化且可组合的 FAOPs 注册表，编译器可以对此进行验证。 四种范式按顺序应用，每种范式的命名都源于其所消除的异常，正如每种关系范式都以其所排除的更新、插入或删除异常命名一样：

sents.en: The four normal forms apply in order, and each is named for the anomaly it removes, just as each relational normal form is named for an update, insertion, or deletion anomaly it rules out:
sents.zh: 四种范式按顺序应用，每种范式的命名都源于其所消除的异常，正如每种关系范式都以其所排除的更新、插入或删除异常命名一样：

paragraphs.en: FNF-1 removes the compound-step anomaly (a leaf that bundles several effects, so it cannot be tested, traced, retried, or priced on its own) by splitting it into atomic steps.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-1 通过将复合步骤异常（即将多个效果捆绑在一起的叶子节点，因此无法单独进行测试、追踪、重试或定价）拆分为原子步骤来消除该问题。

paragraphs.en: FNF-2 removes the missing-field anomaly (a step that reads a field no earlier step produced) by typing the data flow.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-2 通过类型化数据流来消除缺失字段异常（即读取了前一个步骤未生成的字段的步骤）。

paragraphs.en: FNF-3 removes the duplication anomaly (a shared sub-procedure copied across workflows and drifting out of sync, the workflow form of the update anomaly) by factoring it into one canonical FAOP the others call.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-3 通过将重复异常（即跨工作流复制并逐渐不同步的共享子程序，也就是更新异常在工作流中的表现形式）分解为一个标准 FAOP，其他智能体调用该 FAOP，从而消除了这种重复异常。

paragraphs.en: FNF-4 removes the escalation anomaly (a step that reaches a tool, or sheds a guardrail, its parent never granted) by confining each child’s scope to its parent’s.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-4 通过将每个子项的作用域限制在其父项的作用域内，消除了升级异常（即某个步骤触发了工具或突破了护栏，但其父项从未获得相应权限的情况）。

paragraphs.en: The forms are progressive: each takes the previous as given.
paragraphs.zh: 这些形式是递进的：每一种都以前一种为基础。

paragraphs.en: Running example. Examples in this section are drawn from one synthetic finance workflow, issue_statement.v1 , which issues a monthly account statement; Appendix A works it end to end, one normal form at a time. Every example in this paper is synthetic and is used only to illustrate the formalism; it does not describe the internal workflow of any institution and is not intended to mirror how such a task is built in practice.

paragraphs.en: FNF-1 is the decomposition normal form, the analog of first normal form. Just as 1NF requires every cell of a relation to hold one atomic value, FNF-1 requires every leaf of a workflow to perform one atomic unit of work. The grammar of Section 2.3 permits a leaf to do several things at once; FNF-1 is the constraint that removes this freedom and, in doing so, turns a source artifact into a registry of atomic FAOPs.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-1 是分解范式，相当于第一范式。 正如 1NF 要求关系中的每个单元格都只包含一个原子值一样，FNF-1 也要求工作流中的每个叶子节点只执行一个原子单位的工作。 第 2.3 节的文法允许一个叶子节点同时执行多个操作；FNF-1 正是通过消除这种自由度来将源工件转化为原子 FAOP 注册表的一种约束。

paragraphs.en: The input is prose: a single AOP sentence may hide a database read, an external call, and a model call at once. Reaching FNF-1 therefore proceeds in two coupled activities.
paragraphs.zh: 输入是散文：一个 AOP 句子可能同时隐藏着一个数据库读取、一个外部调用和一个模型调用。 因此，达到 FNF-1 需要两个相互关联的活动。

sents.zh: 输入是散文：一个 AOP 句子可能同时隐藏着一个数据库读取、一个外部调用和一个模型调用。

sents.en: Reaching FNF-1 therefore proceeds in two coupled activities.

paragraphs.en: The workflow is first expressed in the grammar of Section 2.3 , so that every step becomes an explicit FAOP rather than a clause inside a sentence. Sequential text becomes 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} ; alternatives become 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} ; repetition becomes 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} ; an explicit human question becomes ι \iota ; a persistence point becomes χ \chi ; and a call to a known registered procedure becomes 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) . The Skill Architect may write this body directly, or a translator model may propose it for architect review; either way the result is an initial registry ℛ 0 \mathcal{R}_{0} whose steps are visible but whose individual leaves may still be coarse. Workflow generators such as AutoFlow [ 12 ] , AFlow [ 13 ] , and Flow-of-Action [ 14 ] provide such source artifacts: their output (a natural-language or code-shaped workflow) becomes the input to the “making steps explicit” pass, which lifts it into the FAOP grammar so the remaining FNF-1–FNF-4 passes can typecheck, scope-check, and register it.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流程首先用第 2.3 节的语法表示，这样每个步骤都成为一个明确的 FAOP，而不是句子中的一个从句。 顺序文本变为 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq}；替代方案变为 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if}；重复变为 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop}；明确的人类问题变为 ι \iota；持久化点变为 χ \chi；对已知注册程序的调用则变为 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id})。 技能架构师可以直接编写此主体，或者由翻译模型提出供架构师审阅；无论哪种方式，结果都是一个初始注册表 ℛ 0 \mathcal{R}_{0}，其中的步骤是可见的，但各个叶子节点可能仍然较为粗略。 工作流程生成器（如 AutoFlow [12]、AFlow [13] 和 Flow-of-Action [14]）提供此类源工件：其输出（自然语言或代码形式的工作流程）成为“使步骤明确”处理阶段的输入，该阶段将其提升至 FAOP 语法中，以便后续的 FNF-1–FNF-4 处理阶段能够进行类型检查、作用域检查和注册。

paragraphs.en: Each explicit leaf is then examined, and a leaf that performs several boundary-crossing effects is split into a sequence of single-effect leaves. The resting point is leaf atomicity : every leaf performs at most one effect, while composites remain the glue that reproduces the original multi-step behavior. FNF-1 is thus a local property, checked on one FAOP at a time. In the running example, a coarse step that reads both transactions and interest splits into two single-effect leaves (Appendix A.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 随后，每个显式叶节点都会被检查，而执行了多次边界穿越效应的叶节点会被拆分成一系列单效应叶节点。 其核心在于叶节点的原子性：每个叶节点最多只执行一个效应，而复合节点则作为粘合剂，重现原有的多步行为。 因此，FNF-1 是一种局部属性，每次仅针对一个 FAOP 进行检查。 在运行示例中，一个同时读取交易和利息的粗略步骤会被拆分成两个单效应叶节点（附录 A.5）。

paragraphs.en: A mutating effect is one externally observable unit of business work that crosses the leaf’s boundary: the line between its internal computation and anything external. The following recurring kinds of leaf each carry at most one such effect and are admissible as atomic; this is a working catalog, not an exhaustive definition:

sents.en: A mutating effect is one externally observable unit of business work that crosses the leaf’s boundary: the line between its internal computation and anything external.

sents.en: The following recurring kinds of leaf each carry at most one such effect and are admissible as atomic; this is a working catalog, not an exhaustive definition:

paragraphs.en: one HTTP request to an external API, such as POST , PUT , PATCH , DELETE , or a recorded GET ;
paragraphs.zh: 一次对外部 API 的 HTTP 请求，例如 POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE，或已记录的 GET；

paragraphs.en: The signature is engineered: a domain adds an operation symbol whenever it introduces a new unit of business work. One may add op email \text{op}_{\text{email}} for sending an email, say, so the compiler and executor treat it as its own effect (one that must not fire twice) rather than a generic HTTP call. The signature also includes op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}} , the effect of a planning leaf : a step that produces a FAOP by selecting and composing existing registered FAOPs or by generating a new body. A planning leaf is an ordinary atomic leaf here; it is what distinguishes the agentic architectural levels of Section 3.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 该签名是经过设计的：每当一个域引入一个新的业务工作单元时，它都会添加一个操作符号。 可以为发送电子邮件添加 op email \text{op}_{\text{email}} 操作，这样编译器和执行器就会将其视为一种独立的效果（这种效果不得重复触发），而不是普通的 HTTP 调用。 该签名还包括 op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}}，即规划叶节点的效果：通过选择并组合已注册的 FAOP 或生成新的主体来产生一个 FAOP 的步骤。 在这里，规划叶节点是一个普通的原子叶节点；正是它区分了第 3.7 节中智能体架构的各个层级。

paragraphs.en: A multi-effect leaf ℓ \ell that performs k > 1 k>1 effects e 1 , … , e k e_{1},\ldots,e_{k} may be replaced by 𝑠𝑒𝑞 ⁡ ( ℓ 1 , … , ℓ k ) \mathit{seq}(\ell_{1},\ldots,\ell_{k}) , where each ℓ i \ell_{i} is a single-effect leaf carrying e i e_{i} , preserving S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}} , S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} , and observational behavior. The equivalence holds by the meaning of sequencing (a leaf running its effects in order denotes the same state transformer as those effects as separate steps of a 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} ) and, the semantics being compositional, it may be substituted in any context; where ℓ \ell is a shared registered FAOP, referential transparency of ℛ \mathcal{R} (Section 2 ) carries the single edit to every call site. The rewrite is reversible up to associativity of 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} (Section 3.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个执行 k > 1 个效果 e₁, …, eₖ 的多效果叶节点 ℓ，可被替换为 𝑠𝑒𝑞⁡(ℓ₁, …, ℓₖ)，其中每个 ℓᵢ 是一个携带效果 eᵢ 的单效果叶节点，同时保持 Sᵢₙ、Sₒᵤₜ 和观测行为不变。 这种等价性源于序列化的定义（按顺序执行效果的叶节点与将这些效果作为 𝑠𝑒𝑞 的独立步骤执行时具有相同的状态变换器），并且由于语义具有组合性，该替换可在任何上下文中进行；其中 ℓ 是一个共享的已注册 FAOP，而 ℛ 的引用透明度（第 2 节）会将这一单处修改传播到所有调用位置。 在 𝑠𝑒𝑞 的结合性（第 3.5 节）范围内，该重写操作是可逆的。

paragraphs.en: The replacement primitive is 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} because a multi-effect leaf, by definition, performs its k k effects unconditionally and in order as a single indivisible unit; if the underlying step instead performed one of two effects based on a condition, or one effect repeatedly until some predicate held, that step was already an 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} or 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} and not a single leaf. Splitting inside those non-sequential composites is straightforward: the same lemma applies to each multi-effect leaf appearing under 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} or 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} , so a body such as 𝑖𝑓 ⁡ ( p , ℓ , g ) \mathit{if}(p,\ell,g) with a multi-effect ℓ \ell splits to 𝑖𝑓 ⁡ ( p , 𝑠𝑒𝑞 ⁡ ( ℓ 1 , … , ℓ k ) , g ) \mathit{if}(p,\mathit{seq}(\ell_{1},\ldots,\ell_{k}),g) by structural recursion.
paragraphs.zh: 替换的原语是 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq}，因为根据定义，一个多效应叶节点会无条件地、按顺序地执行其 k 个效应，作为一个不可分割的整体；如果底层的步骤改为根据某个条件执行两个效应中的一个，或者重复执行某个效应直到某个谓词成立，那么该步骤就已经是一个 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 或 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop}，而不是一个单独的叶节点。 在这些非顺序的复合结构内部进行拆分是直接的：同样的引理适用于每个出现在 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 或 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 下的多效应叶节点，因此像 𝑖𝑓 ⁡ ( p , ℓ , g ) \mathit{if}(p,\ell,g) 这样的主体，其中 ℓ \ell 是一个多效应，通过结构递归可以拆分为 𝑖𝑓 ⁡ ( p , 𝑠𝑒𝑞 ⁡ ( ℓ 1 , … , ℓ k ) , g ) \mathit{if}(p,\mathit{seq}(\ell_{1},\ldots,\ell_{k}),g)。

FNF-1 is then reached by one pass over every registered FAOP that splits each multi-effect leaf into atomic ones.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个活动已经将每个源工件（SOP、AOP 或框架技能）表示为第 2.3 节语法中的 FAOP，从而得到了注册表 ℛ₀ \mathcal{R}_{0}；此时，一个叶节点可能仍然包含多个效应。 接着，通过遍历所有已注册的 FAOP，将每个具有多重效应的叶节点拆分为原子级叶节点，即可到达 FNF-1。

paragraphs.en: The algorithm terminates because each replacement strictly reduces the number of multi-effect leaves. By Lemma 1 each split preserves observational behavior, so the output is observationally equal to ℛ 0 \mathcal{R}_{0} and satisfies FNF-1.
paragraphs.zh: 该算法终止，因为每次替换都会严格减少多效应叶节点的数量。 根据引理 1，每次分裂都保持观察行为不变，因此输出在观察上与 ℛ 0 \mathcal{R}_{0} 相等，并满足 FNF-1。

paragraphs.en: FNF-1 is checked against the declaration, not the implementation, in one O ⁡ ( | F | ) O(|F|) pass per FAOP.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次 FAOP 中，FNF-1 是与声明而非实现进行比对，时间复杂度为 O⁡(|F|)。

paragraphs.en: Soundness of declared effect symbols with respect to the underlying code (whether a leaf labeled op HTTP \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{HTTP}} in fact issues only one external request) is a separate matter, addressed by the type-and-effect literature (Section 6.4 ) as an architect aid.
paragraphs.zh: 声明的效果符号相对于底层代码的健全性（即一个标记为 op HTTP \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{HTTP}} 的叶节点是否实际上仅发出一个外部请求）是一个独立的问题，类型与效果文献（第 6.4 节）将其作为架构辅助手段进行了探讨。

paragraphs.en: FNF-1 converts an opaque prose body into a structured, typed layer of atomic steps the compiler and executor can act on. Most of the benefits reported in Table 5 trace back to this decomposition: it is the precondition on which the later normal forms and their guarantees rest, and without it they are not achievable.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-1 将不透明的散文式内容转换为结构化的、带类型的原子步骤层，供编译器和执行器操作。 表 5 中报告的大多数优势都可追溯至这种分解：它是后续标准形式及其保障所依赖的先决条件，没有它，这些保障便无法实现。

sents.en: Most of the benefits reported in Table 5 trace back to this decomposition: it is the precondition on which the later normal forms and their guarantees rest, and without it they are not achievable.
sents.zh: 表 5 中报告的大多数优势都可追溯至这种分解：它是后续标准形式及其保障所依赖的先决条件，没有它，这些保障便无法实现。

paragraphs.en: The later normal forms build on this structured layer: FNF-2 reasons over schemas, FNF-3 over canonical composites, and FNF-4 over scope.
paragraphs.zh: 后续的正常形式建立在这一结构化层之上：FNF-2 对模式进行推理，FNF-3 对规范组合进行推理，而 FNF-4 则对作用域进行推理。

paragraphs.en: FNF-2 is the no missing ingredients condition. Once FNF-1 has made the workflow’s leaves explicit, FNF-2 checks that every leaf is called only after the fields it needs are already present in the running state. It prevents a workflow from saying, for example, “compute the balance” before any earlier step has produced statement_transactions . Appendix A.6 shows the compiler rejecting a step order in the running example that reads a field before it is produced.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-2 是“不缺少任何成分”的条件。 一旦 FNF-1 使工作流的叶子节点显式化，FNF-2 就会检查每个叶子节点是否仅在所需字段已存在于运行状态之后才被调用。 它能防止工作流出现这样的逻辑：例如，在更早的步骤尚未生成 statement_transactions 之前，就要求“计算余额”。 附录 A.6 展示了编译器如何拒绝运行示例中某个步骤顺序，该顺序试图在字段被生成之前读取它。

paragraphs.en: where the intersection keeps fields present with compatible types in both post-states. This does not mean that fields produced by only one arm are invalid or erased. It means only that an unguarded continuation may read only A join A_{\mathrm{join}} . The compiler also records path-sensitive schemas for the two arms: under predicate p p the state refines to A f A_{f} , and under ¬ p \neg p it refines to A g A_{g} . This is the standard control-flow join problem in static type systems: unguarded continuations see a join of branch post-states, while path-sensitive or union-typed analyzes preserve arm-specific fields under their guards [ 16 , 17 ] . If later logic must use fields that appear on only one arm, it must either remain under the corresponding guard or insert an explicit normalization step that maps both arms to a shared output contract.
paragraphs.zh: 在此处，交叉点会在两种后状态中都保留类型兼容的字段。 这并不意味着仅由一个分支生成的字段无效或被删除。 它仅表示未受保护的延续只能读取 A join A_{\mathrm{join}}。 编译器还会为两个分支记录路径敏感的架构：在谓词 p 下，状态会细化为 A f A_{f}；而在 ¬ p 下，则会细化为 A g A_{g}。 这是静态类型系统中标准的控制流合并问题：未受保护的延续会看到分支后状态的合并，而路径敏感或联合类型的分析则会在其守卫条件下保留各分支特有的字段 [16, 17]。 如果后续逻辑必须使用仅出现在一个分支上的字段，则它要么必须保持在对应的守卫条件下，要么插入一个显式的规范化步骤，将两个分支映射到一个共享的输出契约中。

paragraphs.en: For a loop 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 ⁡ ( f , p ) \mathit{loop}(f,p) , where f f is the loop body and p p is the loop predicate, let A A be the schema available when the loop is entered. The body must be readable from A A , so S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( f ) ⊆ A S_{\mathit{in}}(f)\subseteq A . After one body execution the available schema is A ′ = A ⊎ S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 ​ ( f ) A^{\prime}=A\uplus S_{\mathit{out}}(f) , and the predicate must be readable from A ′ A^{\prime} , so S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( p ) ⊆ A ′ S_{\mathit{in}}(p)\subseteq A^{\prime} . Because the record only grows, the next iteration has at least the fields in A A , so the body remains well-typed across re-entries.

paragraphs.en: FNF ​ - ​ 2 ⁡ ( F ) \operatorname{FNF\text{-}2}(F) holds iff every sequence step satisfies S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( f i ) ⊆ S i − 1 S_{\mathit{in}}(f_{i})\subseteq S_{i-1} , every branch and loop predicate reads only fields available at its program point, branch continuations respect the unguarded join or a valid path-sensitive refinement, and the branch and loop rules above hold recursively for nested constructors.
paragraphs.zh: FNF - 2 ⁡ ( F ) \operatorname{FNF\text{-}2}(F) 成立当且仅当：每个序列步骤都满足 S_{\mathit{in}}(f_{i})\subseteq S_{i-1}，每个分支和循环谓词仅读取其程序点上可用的字段，分支延续遵循无保护合并或有效的路径敏感细化，并且上述分支和循环规则对嵌套构造函数递归成立。

paragraphs.en: The compiler checks FNF-2 by walking the body while carrying the schema available at each feasible control-flow path.
paragraphs.zh: 编译器通过遍历主体，并携带每条可行控制流路径上可用的模式，来检查 FNF-2。

paragraphs.en: The active path schemas can be implemented as a small path environment whose entries pair a guard, such as p p or ¬ p \neg p , with the schema available under that guard. For an unguarded continuation after a branch, the read must succeed for both branch schemas, which is equivalent to reading only A join A_{\mathrm{join}} . For a guarded continuation, infeasible paths are filtered out, so arm-specific fields remain available under their corresponding guard. The loop case follows the repeat-until reading of Section 2.2 : the body runs, the predicate is checked on the body output, and a false predicate re-enters with the running schema. With constant-time guard feasibility checks, the pass is O ⁡ ( | F | ⋅ | 𝒱 | ) O(|F|\cdot|\mathcal{V}|) .
paragraphs.zh: 活跃路径模式可以作为一个小型路径环境来实现，其条目将守卫（例如 p p 或 ¬ p \neg p ）与在该守卫下可用的模式进行配对。 对于分支后的无守卫延续，读取必须对两个分支模式都成功，这等同于仅读取 A join A_{\mathrm{join}} 。 对于有守卫的延续，不可行的路径会被过滤掉，因此特定于臂的字段仍可在其对应的守卫下使用。 循环情况遵循第 2.2 节中的 repeat-until 读取方式：执行主体，对主体的输出检查谓词，如果谓词为假，则使用运行模式重新进入。 在守卫可行性检查为常数时间复杂度的情况下，该过程的时间复杂度为 O ⁡ ( | F | ⋅ | 𝒱 | ) O(|F|\cdot|\mathcal{V}|) 。

paragraphs.en: FNF-2 eliminates runtime missing-field errors, the workflow analog of a compiler rejecting the use of an undeclared variable. Just as a C or Java compiler refuses to build code that reads a name not yet in scope, FNF-2 refuses a workflow in which a step reads a field no earlier step has produced. Every field a step or predicate reads is therefore statically guaranteed to be present on the path where it runs.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-2 消除了运行时缺失字段错误，这类似于编译器拒绝使用未声明变量的工作流程对应情况。 正如 C 或 Java 编译器会拒绝构建读取尚未进入作用域的名称的代码一样，FNF-2 也会拒绝某个流程中某一步骤读取了此前任何步骤均未生成的字段的情况。 因此，每个步骤或谓词所读取的字段，在其执行路径上都会被静态地保证存在。

paragraphs.en: If FNF2Check accepts F F , then in every run of F F each step and predicate uses only fields that are already in the state when it runs.
paragraphs.zh: 如果 FNF2Check 接受 F F，那么在 F F 的每次运行中，每个步骤和谓词都只使用运行时状态中已经存在的字段。

paragraphs.en: Step f i f_{i} is allowed to read a field only when that field already sits in the running schema S i − 1 S_{i-1} (the fields available just before f i f_{i} ) on every path that can reach it, which is the FNF-2 condition S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( f i ) ⊆ S i − 1 S_{\mathit{in}}(f_{i})\subseteq S_{i-1} . Because ⊎ \uplus only adds fields and never drops them, once a field is produced it stays in the state until f i f_{i} runs. A read the checker accepts at compile time is therefore present at run time, and the branch and loop rules carry the same argument into every nested constructor. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 智能体 f_i 仅当该字段在每条能够到达它的路径上均已存在于运行模式 S_{i-1}（即 f_i 执行前即刻可用的字段）中时，才被允许读取该字段；这就是 FNF-2 条件 S_{\mathit{in}}(f_{i})\subseteq S_{i-1}。 由于 ⊎ \uplus 只会添加字段而绝不会移除它们，因此一旦某个字段被生成，它便会一直保留在状态中，直到 f_i 执行完毕。 因此，检查器在编译时接受的读取操作在运行时必然存在，并且分支与循环规则将同样的论证带入每一个嵌套构造器中。∎

paragraphs.en: The schemas computed by FNF-2 also tell Section 3.5 when two steps are independent: neither step reads a field produced only by the other, and they do not write the same field. That condition justifies commutativity and safe parallel execution. The shared-write restriction is necessary because ⊎ \uplus is right-biased (Convention 1 ): if two steps write the same field, swapping their order changes which write wins.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-2 计算出的模式也告诉第 3.5 节，何时两个步骤是独立的：两个步骤都没有读取仅由另一个步骤生成的字段，并且它们也不会写入相同的字段。 该条件证明了交换性和安全的并行执行。 共享写限制是必要的，因为 ⊎ \uplus 是右偏的（约定 1）：如果两个步骤写入相同的字段，交换它们的顺序会改变哪个写入操作最终生效。

paragraphs.en: FNF-1 makes the inside of each FAOP explicit, one workflow at a time. It does not yet say whether a step or sub-procedure that recurs across the firm’s library should have one canonical identity. A registry can satisfy FNF-1 and FNF-2 while still carrying the same business logic in many places, both as a single repeated atomic leaf, such as FetchAccount.v1 inlined in twenty AOPs, and as a repeated multi-step procedure. For example, many workflows may inline the same sequence of GetTransactions.v1 , GetInterest.v1 , and ComputeBalance.v1 even though the organization means the same procedure each time: gather the period’s transactions and interest and compute the balance. FNF-3 says that such a step or procedure should be a registered FAOP (a leaf such as FetchAccount.v1 or a composite such as build_statement_facts.v1 ) and other workflows should call it rather than reconstructing its body. Appendix A.7 extracts this composite from three statement workflows.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-1 使每个 FAOP 的内部结构清晰可见，一次处理一个工作流。 目前尚未说明，跨企业库重复使用的步骤或子程序是否应具有唯一的规范身份。 一个注册表可以满足 FNF-1 和 FNF-2，同时仍可在多处保留相同的业务逻辑，既可以是单个重复的原子叶节点（例如，内联于二十个 AOP 中的 FetchAccount.v1），也可以是重复的多步骤程序。 例如，许多工作流可能会内联相同的 GetTransactions.v1、GetInterest.v1 和 ComputeBalance.v1 序列，尽管组织上每次执行都代表同一个程序：收集该周期的交易和利息，并计算余额。 FNF-3 指出，此类步骤或程序应是一个已注册的 FAOP（如 FetchAccount.v1 这样的叶节点，或 build_statement_facts.v1 这样的组合节点），而其他工作流应调用它，而不是重新构建其主体。 附录 A.7 从三个报表工作流中提取了该组合节点。

paragraphs.en: The benefit is registry integrity and discipline. A canonical composite has one name, owner, version, description, test boundary, observability boundary, and impact-analysis target. Without that canonical entry, copies can drift: one workflow adds a validation step, another changes a saved field, and a third forgets an audit event, while all still appear to implement the same business procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 其好处在于确保注册表的完整性和规范性。 一个标准组合体包含一个名称、所有者、版本、描述、测试边界、可观察性边界以及影响分析目标。 如果没有这个标准条目，各个副本就可能逐渐产生差异：一个工作流添加了一个验证步骤，另一个修改了某个已保存的字段，第三个则遗漏了一项审计事件，而所有这些副本表面上仍然都在实现相同的业务流程。

sents.en: The benefit is registry integrity and discipline.
sents.zh: 其好处在于确保注册表的完整性和规范性。

paragraphs.en: Factoring also removes a subtler anomaly. Representing every reusable step as a 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) edge turns the registry into an explicit call graph, which Convention 2 keeps acyclic. The anomaly this rules out is a procedure that, through its chain of calls, transitively re-invokes itself. In an unstructured library such a cycle is invisible (no one follows the transitive closure of “and then run the onboarding flow”), yet at runtime it recurses without bound and the agent hangs. Just as a relational normal form turns an update anomaly into a schema-level impossibility, factoring turns this recursion anomaly into a compile-time rejection: a topological sort of ℛ \mathcal{R} . Acyclicity is the composition-level half of termination, ruling out recursion, while +V (Section 3.6.2 ) rules out unbounded looping; together they let the compiler inline the workflow into a finite tree with a computable worst-case bound (+B).
paragraphs.zh: 因式分解还能消除一种更隐蔽的异常。 将每个可重用的步骤表示为一条 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) 边，会将注册表转化为一个显式的调用图，而约定 2 确保了该图无环。 这种异常所排除的情况是：某个过程通过其调用链，间接地重新调用了自身。 在一个非结构化的库中，这样的循环是不可见的（没有人会追踪“然后运行入职流程”的传递闭包），但在运行时，它会导致无限递归，使智能体陷入挂起状态。 正如关系范式将更新异常转化为模式层面的不可能性一样，因式分解也将这种递归异常转化为编译时的拒绝：即对 ℛ \mathcal{R} 进行拓扑排序。 无环性是终止性的组合层面保障，它排除了递归；而 +V（第 3.6.2 节）则排除了无限循环；二者结合后，编译器便可将工作流内联为一个具有可计算最坏情况界限（+B）的有限树。

paragraphs.en: Factoring is not decided by reuse count alone. Repeated structure is a strong compiler signal, but even if a body never repeats, the Skill Architect may still elect to make it a canonical FAOP because it has domain meaning, governance value, testing value, observability value, lifecycle ownership, or expected future reuse.

Let Π comp ​ ( s , ℛ ) \Pi_{\mathrm{comp}}(s,\mathcal{R}) be the architect policy that decides whether a sub-workflow s s should have a canonical registered FAOP. The compiler can list all repeated sub-trees and tagged sub-workflows as candidates, but candidate detection is not the same as extraction. The Skill Architect applies Π comp \Pi_{\mathrm{comp}} to decide which candidates become canonical FAOPs. The policy may inspect reuse count, metadata, tags, ownership rules, and compiler-suggested duplicate sub-trees.

paragraphs.en: FNF-4 is the least-privilege condition: each step gets only the permissions it needs, and no more. It ensures that as control moves from parent to child in the workflow, permissions can only stay the same or shrink, and restrictions can only stay the same or grow. A child step cannot gain capabilities its parent never declared, and it cannot escape constraints its parent imposed.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-4 是最小权限原则：每个步骤仅获得其所需的权限，不多也不少。 它确保在流程中控制从父节点传递到子节点时，权限只能保持不变或减少，而限制只能保持不变或增加。 子步骤无法获得其父节点从未声明的能力，也无法突破其父节点所施加的约束。

sents.en: FNF-4 is the least-privilege condition: each step gets only the permissions it needs, and no more.
sents.zh: FNF-4 是最小权限原则：每个步骤仅获得其所需的权限，不多也不少。

sents.en: It ensures that as control moves from parent to child in the workflow, permissions can only stay the same or shrink, and restrictions can only stay the same or grow.

sents.en: A child step cannot gain capabilities its parent never declared, and it cannot escape constraints its parent imposed.
sents.zh: 子步骤无法获得其父节点从未声明的能力，也无法突破其父节点所施加的约束。

paragraphs.en: A single step restricted to permitted tools, 𝒯 s ⊆ 𝒯 permitted \mathcal{T}_{s}\subseteq\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{permitted}} , is the standard capability model, enforced at runtime [ 1 ] . FNF-4 makes it compositional and static : the tool ceiling can only shrink from parent to child, so privilege escalation assembled through composition is caught at compile time, not call by call.
paragraphs.zh: 仅限制于允许工具的单一步骤，即 𝒯 s ⊆ 𝒯 permitted \mathcal{T}_{s}\subseteq\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{permitted}} ，是标准的能力模型，并在运行时强制执行 [ 1 ] 。 FNF-4 使其具有组合性和静态性：工具的上限只能从父节点向子节点缩小，因此通过组合构建的特权提升会在编译时就被捕获，而非在每次调用时检查。

paragraphs.en: All names used in any scope dimension (tool names, guardrail names, field names) must exist in a controlled name catalog 𝒱 names \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{names}} maintained per registry (the concrete implementation, discussed in Section 4 , is called SkillBase ). If a FAOP references a tool or guardrail that is not in the catalog, the compiler rejects it before any scope check begins. This prevents semantic drift, such as client_id versus id_client , from silently breaking scope verification.
paragraphs.zh: 任何作用域维度中使用的名称（工具名称、护栏名称、字段名称）都必须存在于受控的名称目录 𝒱 names \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{names}} 中，该目录由每个注册表维护（具体实现将在第 4 节中讨论，称为 SkillBase）。 如果某个 FAOP 引用了目录中不存在的工具或护栏，编译器会在任何作用域检查开始之前拒绝该引用。 这可以防止语义漂移（例如 client_id 与 id_client）悄无声息地破坏作用域验证。

paragraphs.en: The ceiling dimension is monotone non-increasing along every parent-child edge, and the floor dimension is monotone non-decreasing.
paragraphs.zh: 天花板维度沿每条父子边单调非递增，而地板维度则单调非递减。

paragraphs.en: FNF-4 is checked by a single root-to-leaf traversal.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-4 通过一次从根到叶的遍历进行检查。

paragraphs.en: The traversal is O ⁡ ( | F | ⋅ | Σ max | ) O(|F|\cdot|\Sigma_{\max}|) , where Σ max \Sigma_{\max} is the largest scope size encountered. FNF-4 eliminates privilege escalation and guardrail evasion through composition: no descendant can reach a tool its ancestors did not grant, or shed a guardrail they imposed.
paragraphs.zh: 遍历的时间复杂度为 O(|F|⋅|Σ_max|)，其中 Σ_max 是所遇到的最大作用域大小。 FNF-4 通过组合设计消除了权限提升和防护机制规避：任何子智能体都无法使用其祖先未授予的工具，也无法解除祖先所施加的防护机制。

sents.en: FNF-4 eliminates privilege escalation and guardrail evasion through composition: no descendant can reach a tool its ancestors did not grant, or shed a guardrail they imposed.

paragraphs.en: If FNF4Check accepts F F , then on every trace each descendant F ′ F^{\prime} invokes only tools in 𝒯 ⁡ ( F ) \mathcal{T}(F) and obeys every guardrail in 𝒢 ⁡ ( F ) \mathcal{G}(F) .

paragraphs.en: Along any root-to- F ′ F^{\prime} path the check gives 𝒯 ⁡ ( child ) ⊆ 𝒯 ⁡ ( parent ) \mathcal{T}(\text{child})\subseteq\mathcal{T}(\text{parent}) and 𝒢 ⁡ ( parent ) ⊆ 𝒢 ⁡ ( child ) \mathcal{G}(\text{parent})\subseteq\mathcal{G}(\text{child}) at each edge; composing the inclusions yields 𝒯 ⁡ ( F ′ ) ⊆ 𝒯 ⁡ ( F ) \mathcal{T}(F^{\prime})\subseteq\mathcal{T}(F) and 𝒢 ⁡ ( F ) ⊆ 𝒢 ⁡ ( F ′ ) \mathcal{G}(F)\subseteq\mathcal{G}(F^{\prime}) . A leaf invokes only tools in its own 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , and loops re-enter the same body with the same scope. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 在从根节点到 F ′ F^{\prime} 的任何路径上，检查在每个边处都满足 𝒯 ⁡ ( child ) ⊆ 𝒯 ⁡ ( parent ) \mathcal{T}(\text{child})\subseteq\mathcal{T}(\text{parent}) 和 𝒢 ⁡ ( parent ) ⊆ 𝒢 ⁡ ( child ) \mathcal{G}(\text{parent})\subseteq\mathcal{G}(\text{child})；将这些包含关系组合起来，可得 𝒯 ⁡ ( F ′ ) ⊆ 𝒯 ⁡ ( F ) \mathcal{T}(F^{\prime})\subseteq\mathcal{T}(F) 和 𝒢 ⁡ ( F ) ⊆ 𝒢 ⁡ ( F ′ ) \mathcal{G}(F)\subseteq\mathcal{G}(F^{\prime})。 叶节点仅调用其自身 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 中的工具，而循环会带着相同的范围重新进入同一个主体。 ∎

paragraphs.en: Even if a step is hijacked (say, by prompt injection), FNF-4 caps what it can touch: it can use only the tools and data its own scope grants, so it cannot call the payments tool unless that tool is in its scope. FNF-4 does not stop the step from being hijacked in the first place; preventing that (prompt injection, or a malicious skill [ 18 ] ) is a separate problem FAOP does not address.
paragraphs.zh: 即使某个步骤被劫持（例如通过提示注入），FNF-4 能触及的内容也是有限的：它只能使用其自身作用域所授予的工具和数据，因此除非该支付工具在其作用域内，否则它无法调用支付工具。 FNF-4 并不会阻止步骤本身从一开始就被劫持；防止这种情况发生（例如提示注入或恶意技能 [ 18 ]）是一个独立的问题，而 FAOP 并未解决这一问题。

paragraphs.en: An algebra is three things: a carrier of objects, operations that combine them, and laws that equate combinations with the same meaning. For FAOP the carrier is the set of well-typed (FNF-2) bodies, the operations are the primitives of Section 2.2 , and the laws are five equations (L1–L5) a compiler applies as directed rewrites. We fix each in turn, then prove the laws sound against a denotational semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 代数包含三个要素：一个对象载体、用于组合这些对象的运算，以及将具有相同意义的组合视为相等的法则。 对于 FAOP，其载体是类型正确的（FNF-2）主体集合，运算是第 2.2 节中的基本操作，而法则则是编译器作为指导重写所应用的五个等式（L1–L5）。 我们依次确定每个要素，然后证明这些法则在指涉语义下是健全的。

paragraphs.en: Every body f f denotes a typed state transformer [ [ f ] ] : S 𝑖𝑛 → S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 \mathopen{[\![}f\mathclose{]\!]}:S_{\mathit{in}}\to S_{\mathit{out}} (Definition 1, Convention 1 ). Sequential composition 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} is the product and the empty step id its unit; branch 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} , loop 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} , and call 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 \mathit{call} are the control constructors. Parallel 𝑝𝑎𝑟 \mathit{par} is not a primitive but a derived operator, equal to 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} on independent steps (L3). The algebra is therefore the classical algebra of pure functions under composition, specialized to FAOP by construction.

paragraphs.en: Reachability then settles every scheduling question: two steps may be reordered exactly when neither can reach the other, any set of mutually unreachable steps (an antichain) can run in parallel, and every topological order preserves the workflow’s meaning. Building the graph costs O ⁡ ( n 2 ​ s ) O(n^{2}s) for n n siblings of schema size s ≤ | 𝒱 | s\leq|\mathcal{V}| (the pairwise test over all pairs), after which a maximally parallel schedule is the antichain layering by longest path, O ⁡ ( n + e ) O(n+e) in the edge count e e . Soundness needs honest schemas (an under-declared footprint or two names aliasing one resource can hide a conflict), which is why FNF-3’s vocabulary and FNF-4’s scope are prerequisites. Per-FAOP scoping (Convention 1 ) is the runtime counterpart: because a callee’s locals stay in its own frame and only its declared S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} escapes, two steps interact only through declared fields, so the dependence graph captures every possible interaction. Parallel execution is then sound not just as a reordering (the L3 equation) but as genuine simultaneity: two siblings running at the same time cannot see or overwrite each other’s intermediate fields, since each runs in its own scope and exposes only its declared S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} .
paragraphs.zh: 可达性随后解决了所有调度问题：两个步骤恰好在其彼此都无法到达时可以被重新排序；任何一组相互不可达的步骤（一个反链）都可以并行执行；并且每个拓扑顺序都保留了工作流的意义。 构建该图需要 O(n²s) 的时间，其中 n 是大小为 s ≤ |𝒱| 的模式中的兄弟节点数（对所有节点对进行成对测试），之后，最大并行调度方案即为按最长路径分层的反链结构，其时间复杂度为 O(n + e)，其中 e 是边数。 正确性需要诚实的模式（未充分声明的足迹或两个名称指向同一资源的情况可能会隐藏冲突），因此 FNF-3 的词汇表和 FNF-4 的作用域是先决条件。 每个 FAOP 的作用域限定（约定 1）是运行时对应的机制：因为被调用函数的局部变量保留在其自身的帧中，且只有其声明的 S_out 会逃逸出去，因此两个步骤仅通过已声明的字段进行交互，这样依赖图就能捕捉到所有可能的交互。 因此，并行执行不仅是作为重排序（L3 方程）是正确的，更是作为真正的同步操作是正确的：同时运行的两个兄弟节点无法看到或覆盖彼此的中间字段，因为每个节点都在自己的作用域中运行，并且只暴露其声明的 S_out。

paragraphs.en: Three honesty conditions (each just restating a rule the normal forms already enforce) make the model exact. (A1) Honest footprint: a leaf’s output record δ ℓ ​ ( σ ) \delta_{\ell}(\sigma) is fixed by the fields it declares to read plus its own effect outcome, and it never reads an undeclared field: this is what a truthful FNF-2 schema means. (A2) Outcomes follow the leaf: the result of a nondeterministic effect (say, an LLM call) is fixed once as a value (a single draw from its distribution) that belongs to the leaf’s identity, not to its position in the running order; reordering the leaf does not change its value. With every such outcome fixed, each body [ [ f ] ] \mathopen{[\![}f\mathclose{]\!]} is an ordinary deterministic function, so the laws hold for the fixed outcomes and therefore also in distribution. (A3) Pure predicates: a branch test reads only stored fields ( Comp ⁡ ( p ) \operatorname{Comp}(p) , Section 3.7 ); a decision that needs the model is first computed by an atomic leaf (FNF-1) and stored, then read purely.
paragraphs.zh: 三个诚实性条件（每个条件都只是在重申常规形式已经强制执行的规则）使模型变得精确。 （A1）诚实的足迹：叶节点的输出记录 δ ℓ ​ ( σ ) \delta_{\ell}(\sigma) 由其声明要读取的字段及其自身的效果结果共同确定，且它绝不会读取未声明的字段：这就是一个真实的 FNF-2 模式所表达的含义。 （A2）结果跟随叶节点：非确定性效果（例如 LLM 调用）的结果一旦被确定为某个值（即从其分布中抽取的一个单一值），该值就属于叶节点的自身身份，而非其在执行顺序中的位置；重新排列叶节点不会改变其值。 由于每个此类结果都已确定，因此每个体 [ [ f ] ] \mathopen{[\![}f\mathclose{]\!]} 都是一个普通的确定性函数，所以这些定律对已确定的结果成立，从而在分布上同样成立。 （A3）纯谓词：分支测试仅读取已存储的字段（ Comp ⁡ ( p ) \operatorname{Comp}(p) ，第 3.7 节）；需要依赖模型的决定首先由一个原子叶节点（FNF-1）计算并存储，然后以纯方式读取。

paragraphs.en: As directed rewrites the laws are the compiler’s optimizations (Table 4 ), and they ground FNF-3: L2 groups a contiguous sub-sequence and L5 names it 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) (extract/inline), while L4 factors a shared post-branch step through a branch. FNF-3 is thus normalization driven by the laws: it only decides when to apply these always-sound moves and fixes the one canonical identity. L3 is the compiler’s parallelization rule: independent steps, read off the dependence graph, run concurrently to cut wall-clock latency. This and further schema-driven rewrites (interrupt fusion, dead-step elimination, loop unrolling) are cataloged with +O (Section 3.6 ). Appendix A.10 applies each law to the running example.

paragraphs.en: A FAOP that satisfies all four normal forms is structurally well-formed: its leaves are explicit (FNF-1), its data flows are sound (FNF-2), its reusable composites are canonical (FNF-3), and its ceiling scope only narrows downward while its guardrails accumulate (FNF-4). Structural well-formedness is necessary for safe composition, but it is not sufficient for all engineering concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 满足全部四种正常形式的 FAOP 在结构上是良好形成的：其叶节点是显式的（FNF-1），其数据流是健全的（FNF-2），其可重用的组合体是规范化的（FNF-3），并且其上限作用域仅向下收缩，同时其护栏逐步累积（FNF-4）。 结构上的良好形成性对于安全组合是必要的，但它并不足以满足所有工程需求。

paragraphs.en: Extensions are denoted by a + prefix and are recorded in the FAOP’s signature (Section 3.8 ) alongside the normal-form level. paragraphs.en: Even a structurally well-formed workflow may run steps in a strictly sequential order that no data dependency requires, or force a user through several round-trips that could have been asked at once. Extension +O certifies that the compiler has applied all safe, semantics-preserving rewrites that reduce execution cost without changing the workflow’s logical outcome. Two instances are given below; the full catalog of +O rewrites is ongoing research.

paragraphs.en: Interrupt fusion. If adjacent interrupts { ι ⁡ ( q 1 , k 1 ) , … , ι ⁡ ( q m , k m ) } \{\iota(q_{1},k_{1}),\ldots,\iota(q_{m},k_{m})\} in a 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} node have pairwise disjoint query keys, they are fused into a single compound interrupt ι ⁡ ( { q 1 , … , q m } , k ) \iota(\{q_{1},\ldots,q_{m}\},k) , reducing m m user round-trips to one.
paragraphs.zh: 中断融合。 如果 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} 节点中相邻的中断 { ι ⁡ ( q 1 , k 1 ) , … , ι ⁡ ( q m , k m ) } \{\iota(q_{1},k_{1}),\ldots,\iota(q_{m},k_{m})\} 的查询键两两互斥，它们将被融合为一个复合中断 ι ⁡ ( { q 1 , … , q m } , k ) \iota(\{q_{1},\ldots,q_{m}\},k) ，从而将 m m 次用户往返请求减少到一次。

paragraphs.en: A structurally sound workflow can still loop forever, or contain a branch arm that no input can ever reach. Extension +V rules out both.
paragraphs.zh: 结构上健全的流程仍然可能无限循环，或者包含一个任何输入都无法触及的分支。 扩展 +V 规则排除了这两种情况。

sents.zh: 结构上健全的流程仍然可能无限循环，或者包含一个任何输入都无法触及的分支。

sents.en: Extension +V rules out both.
sents.zh: 扩展 +V 规则排除了这两种情况。

paragraphs.en: A FAOP F F satisfies +V iff (i) every 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 ⁡ ( f , p ) \mathit{loop}(f,p) in b ⁡ ( F ) b(F) declares a maximum iteration count N max N_{\max} , which is mandatory and bounds the loop unconditionally; and (ii) every 𝑖𝑓 ⁡ ( p , f , g ) \mathit{if}(p,f,g) in b ⁡ ( F ) b(F) has both arms reachable, meaning some valid input s ∈ S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( F ) s\in S_{\mathit{in}}(F) makes p ⁡ ( s ) = true p(s)=\texttt{true} and some other makes it false . Where a loop also admits a well-founded measure μ : S → ℕ \mu:S\to\mathbb{N} that strictly decreases each iteration, the architect declares it, and +V additionally verifies that the loop makes real progress rather than merely being capped.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 FAOP F F 满足 +V 当且仅当：(i) b ⁡ ( F ) b(F) 中的每个 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 ⁡ ( f , p ) \mathit{loop}(f,p) 都声明了一个最大迭代次数 N max N_{\max}，该次数是强制性的且无条件地限制了循环；以及 (ii) b ⁡ ( F ) b(F) 中的每个 𝑖𝑓 ⁡ ( p , f , g ) \mathit{if}(p,f,g) 的两个分支均可到达，即存在某个有效输入 s ∈ S 𝑖𝑛 ​ ( F ) s\in S_{\mathit{in}}(F) 使得 p ⁡ ( s ) = true p(s)=\texttt{true}，也存在另一个输入使其为 false。 如果某个循环还允许一个良基度量 μ : S → ℕ \mu:S\to\mathbb{N}，该度量在每次迭代中严格递减，那么架构师会声明这一点，并且 +V 还会进一步验证该循环确实实现了实际进展，而不仅仅是被限制在某个上限。

sents.en: Where a loop also admits a well-founded measure μ : S → ℕ \mu:S\to\mathbb{N} that strictly decreases each iteration, the architect declares it, and +V additionally verifies that the loop makes real progress rather than merely being capped.
sents.zh: 如果某个循环还允许一个良基度量 μ : S → ℕ \mu:S\to\mathbb{N}，该度量在每次迭代中严格递减，那么架构师会声明这一点，并且 +V 还会进一步验证该循环确实实现了实际进展，而不仅仅是被限制在某个上限。

paragraphs.en: A measure μ \mu , when present, is a typed expression over the loop’s running state, for example the length of the unprocessed-items list. Its decrease, and each branch’s reachability, are ordinary satisfiability queries in the same decidable typed-predicate class used by 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} conditions. Termination and ranking-function analysis is a mature, extensively studied area [ 21 ] , so +V reuses it directly rather than adding any new prover technology.
paragraphs.zh: 一个度量 μ \mu（如果存在）是循环运行状态上的一个带类型表达式，例如未处理项列表的长度。 它的减少以及每个分支的可达性，都是同一可判定带类型谓词类中的普通可满足性查询，该类别也用于 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 条件。 终止性和排名函数分析是一个成熟且被广泛研究的领域 [ 21 ]，因此 +V 直接复用这一方法，而不是添加任何新的证明器技术。

sents.en: Its decrease, and each branch’s reachability, are ordinary satisfiability queries in the same decidable typed-predicate class used by 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} conditions.

sents.en: Termination and ranking-function analysis is a mature, extensively studied area [ 21 ] , so +V reuses it directly rather than adding any new prover technology.
sents.zh: 终止性和排名函数分析是一个成熟且被广泛研究的领域 [ 21 ]，因此 +V 直接复用这一方法，而不是添加任何新的证明器技术。

paragraphs.en: The one place FAOP goes beyond this classical analysis is non-determinism. A loop’s stopping condition may depend on the result of a tool or an AI call rather than on the typed state: a loop that runs until an LLM judges the result good enough, or until an external service signals completion (iterative refinement, multi-agent dialogue, generate-and-check). Then no measure can be synthesized, because progress is not a function of the state. The mandatory N max N_{\max} is what preserves the termination guarantee in these cases: the loop stops after at most N max N_{\max} passes regardless. A measure, where one exists, adds the further assurance that the loop also finishes for the right reason.
paragraphs.zh: FAOP 超越这一经典分析的唯一方面在于非确定性。 循环的终止条件可能取决于工具或 AI 调用的结果，而非类型化的状态：例如，循环会运行直到 LLM 判断结果足够好，或者直到外部服务发出完成信号（迭代优化、多智能体对话、生成与验证）。 此时便无法合成任何度量，因为进展并非状态的函数。 强制性的 N max N_{\max} 正是在这些情况下保留了终止保证：无论何种情况，循环最多经过 N max N_{\max} 次迭代后就会停止。 如果存在某种度量，它还能进一步确保循环确实因正确的理由而结束。

sents.en: The one place FAOP goes beyond this classical analysis is non-determinism.

paragraphs.en: If F F satisfies +V, every 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} in F F halts after at most N max N_{\max} iterations and every 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} arm is reachable; together with the acyclic call graph (FNF-3), F F itself terminates.
paragraphs.zh: 如果 F F 满足 +V，那么 F F 中的每个 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 最多经过 N max N_{\max} 次迭代后就会停止，并且每个 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 分支都是可达的；结合无环调用图（FNF-3），F F 本身也会终止。

paragraphs.en: The mandatory cap bounds each loop unconditionally, and each arm’s reachability is the discharged satisfiability obligation. Acyclicity inlines F F to a finite tree of bounded loops, so its worst-case step count is finite. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 强制性上限无条件地限制每个循环，而每个臂的可达性即已解除的可满足性义务。 无环性将 F F 内联到一个具有有限循环的有限树中，因此其最坏情况下的步数是有限的。∎

paragraphs.en: Even a terminating, parallelized workflow may have no declared upper bound on how long or how much each action costs. Extension +B certifies that every action leaf declares explicit time and cost bounds, enabling SLA enforcement and resource planning.
paragraphs.zh: 即使是一个可终止的并行化工作流，也可能没有明确声明的每个动作所需时间或成本的上线。 扩展 +B 确保每个动作叶节点都声明了明确的时间与成本界限，从而支持服务等级协议的执行和资源规划。

sents.en: Even a terminating, parallelized workflow may have no declared upper bound on how long or how much each action costs.
sents.zh: 即使是一个可终止的并行化工作流，也可能没有明确声明的每个动作所需时间或成本的上线。

sents.en: Extension +B certifies that every action leaf declares explicit time and cost bounds, enabling SLA enforcement and resource planning.
sents.zh: 扩展 +B 确保每个动作叶节点都声明了明确的时间与成本界限，从而支持服务等级协议的执行和资源规划。

The composite bound of a 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} is the sum of its children’s bounds; the composite bound of an 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} is the maximum across its arms; and the composite bound of a 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} is N max ⋅ bound ⁡ ( f ) N_{\max}\cdot\operatorname{bound}(f) , using the maximum iteration count N max N_{\max} supplied by +V.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 FAOP F F 满足 +B，当且仅当每个动作叶节点 a ∈ leaves(F) 都声明了一对 (τ_max(a), c_max(a))，其中 τ_max(a) 是单次调用的最大实际运行延迟，而 c_max(a) 是其最大成本：货币成本，或者对于 LLM 操作 op_LLM 叶节点而言是令牌数量。 一个序列 𝑠𝑒𝑞 的复合界限是其子节点界限之和；一个条件判断 𝑖𝑓 的复合界限是其各分支中的最大值；而一个循环 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 的复合界限为 N_max ⋅ bound(f)，其中 N_max 是由 +V 提供的最大迭代次数。

sents.zh: 一个序列 𝑠𝑒𝑞 的复合界限是其子节点界限之和；一个条件判断 𝑖𝑓 的复合界限是其各分支中的最大值；而一个循环 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 的复合界限为 N_max ⋅ bound(f)，其中 N_max 是由 +V 提供的最大迭代次数。

paragraphs.en: Prerequisite: +V, because bounding a loop requires its maximum iteration count. The executor can enforce per-step timeouts and token caps, the compiler can compute a worst-case latency and cost for the whole workflow, and deployment policy can reject workflows that exceed budget.
paragraphs.zh: 前提条件：+V，因为限制循环需要知道其最大迭代次数。 执行器可以强制执行每一步的时间限制和令牌上限，编译器可以计算整个工作流的最坏情况延迟和成本，而部署策略则可以拒绝超出预算的工作流。

sents.en: Prerequisite: +V, because bounding a loop requires its maximum iteration count.
sents.zh: 前提条件：+V，因为限制循环需要知道其最大迭代次数。

sents.en: The executor can enforce per-step timeouts and token caps, the compiler can compute a worst-case latency and cost for the whole workflow, and deployment policy can reject workflows that exceed budget.

paragraphs.en: If F F satisfies +B (hence +V), the bottom-up bound bound ⁡ ( F ) \operatorname{bound}(F) is an upper bound on the latency and cost of every run of F F .
paragraphs.zh: 如果 F F 满足 +B（因此也满足 +V），那么自底向上界 bound ⁡ ( F ) \operatorname{bound}(F) 是 F F 每次运行延迟和成本的一个上界。

paragraphs.en: Each action leaf declares ( τ max , c max ) (\tau_{\max},c_{\max}) ; by induction on the body tree, 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} sums its children’s bounds, 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} takes their maximum, and 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} multiplies by the finite N max N_{\max} supplied by +V, so the composite bound dominates every run. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 每个动作叶节点都声明了 ( τ max , c max ) (\tau_{\max},c_{\max})；通过对主体树进行归纳，𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} 将其子节点的界限相加，𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 取它们的最大值，而 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 则乘以由 +V 提供的有限值 N max N_{\max}，因此复合界限支配了每一次运行。∎

paragraphs.en: New extensions can be defined for domain-specific guarantees without altering the core or the four normal forms. Two important examples are transactional atomicity (+T), where an agent that moves money, sends messages, or writes to external systems needs an all-or-nothing commit so that a partial failure never leaves the outside world half-updated, and compile-time state contracts (+C), which check that the values passing between steps satisfy declared pre/post conditions and invariants before deployment. Both matter for real-world AI agents, and we plan to develop them in the near future (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 无需修改核心或四种范式，即可为特定领域的保证定义新的扩展。 两个重要的例子是事务原子性（+T）：一个进行资金转移、发送消息或写入外部系统的智能体需要采用“全有或全无”的提交机制，以确保部分故障绝不会使外部世界处于半更新状态；以及编译时状态契约（+C）：在部署前检查各步骤之间传递的值是否满足已声明的预/后置条件和不变量。 这两者对现实世界中的 AI 智能体都至关重要，我们计划在未来不久开发它们（第 7 节）。

sents.zh: 无需修改核心或四种范式，即可为特定领域的保证定义新的扩展。

paragraphs.en: The normal forms certify that a workflow is structurally correct, and the extensions add behavioral guarantees. Neither answers a question organizations must settle before building anything: does this use case need AI at all, and if so, what kind? Today this is decided by intuition or vendor framing, at two costs: paying for a model where a deterministic procedure would do, and, conversely, subjecting a deterministic tool to the heavyweight governance reserved for autonomous systems: for example, weeks of model-risk committee review, mandatory human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and quarterly re-certification, when the artifact in question is in fact a fixed pipeline of typed database and API calls that a single line of test would cover. The decision is hard to make on an unstructured AOP because the model requirement is hidden inside opaque prose. Normalization removes this obstacle: FNF-1 exposes every step as a separate, effect-labeled leaf and FNF-2 gives each a typed contract, so the need for a model can be assessed at the granularity of individual leaves and routing predicates rather than for the workflow as a whole. FAOP therefore turns the decision into a classification computed from the normalized body.
paragraphs.zh: 范式证明了工作流在结构上的正确性，而扩展部分则增加了行为层面的保障。 这两者都无法回答组织在构建任何事物之前必须解决的一个问题：这个用例到底是否需要人工智能？如果需要，又需要哪种类型？ 目前，这一决策依赖于直觉或供应商的引导，并带来两种成本：一方面为原本可用确定性流程解决的问题支付模型费用；另一方面，则让一个确定性工具承受本应保留给自主系统的繁复治理机制——例如，耗时数周的风险模型委员会审查、强制性的“人在回路”检查点以及每季度重新认证，尽管相关产物实际上只是一个由类型化数据库调用和 API 调用构成的固定流程，一条测试代码即可覆盖。 在一个非结构化的 AOP 中，这一决策难以做出，因为模型需求被隐藏在晦涩难懂的文字描述之中。 范式化消除了这一障碍：FNF-1 将每个步骤暴露为一个带有独立效果标签的叶子节点，而 FNF-2 则为每个叶子节点定义了类型化的契约，从而使得模型需求的评估可以细化到单个叶子节点和路由谓词层面，而非针对整个工作流。 因此，FAOP 将这一决策转化为基于范式化主体计算得出的一种分类。

sents.zh: 范式证明了工作流在结构上的正确性，而扩展部分则增加了行为层面的保障。
