paragraphs.en: The classification rests on two tests, both decided by static inspection of the typed body. A leaf is deterministic, written Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \operatorname{Det}(\ell) , when its effect label is neither op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} nor op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}} : the step is a tool, DB, API, file, queue, or value computation ( op compute \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{compute}} ) rather than a model call or a planning step. A predicate is computable, written Comp ⁡ ( p ) \operatorname{Comp}(p) , when the branch or loop condition is an ordinary typed boolean over fields already in the state, for example balance < 0 , rather than a judgment delegated to the model.
paragraphs.zh: 该分类基于两项测试，而这两项测试均通过对类型化主体的静态检查来决定。 当叶节点的效果标签既不是 op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} 也不是 op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}} 时，该叶节点是确定性的，记作 Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \operatorname{Det}(\ell)：此时该步骤是一个工具、数据库、API、文件、队列或值计算（op compute \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{compute}}），而非模型调用或规划步骤。 当分支或循环条件是一个基于状态中已有字段的普通类型化布尔值时（例如 balance < 0），该谓词是可计算的，记作 Comp ⁡ ( p ) \operatorname{Comp}(p)；此时该条件并非委托给模型的判断。

sents.en: The classification rests on two tests, both decided by static inspection of the typed body.
sents.zh: 该分类基于两项测试，而这两项测试均通过对类型化主体的静态检查来决定。

sents.en: A leaf is deterministic, written Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \operatorname{Det}(\ell) , when its effect label is neither op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} nor op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}} : the step is a tool, DB, API, file, queue, or value computation ( op compute \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{compute}} ) rather than a model call or a planning step.
sents.zh: 当叶节点的效果标签既不是 op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} 也不是 op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}} 时，该叶节点是确定性的，记作 Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \operatorname{Det}(\ell)：此时该步骤是一个工具、数据库、API、文件、队列或值计算（op compute \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{compute}}），而非模型调用或规划步骤。

sents.en: A predicate is computable, written Comp ⁡ ( p ) \operatorname{Comp}(p) , when the branch or loop condition is an ordinary typed boolean over fields already in the state, for example balance < 0 , rather than a judgment delegated to the model.
sents.zh: 当分支或循环条件是一个基于状态中已有字段的普通类型化布尔值时（例如 balance < 0），该谓词是可计算的，记作 Comp ⁡ ( p ) \operatorname{Comp}(p)；此时该条件并非委托给模型的判断。

paragraphs.en: Planning is itself a valid FAOP action: a planning leaf carries the effect label op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}} from the effect signature (Section 3.1 ) and produces a FAOP either by selecting and composing existing registered FAOPs, or by generating a new body. A planner is therefore an ordinary FAOP whose body contains a planning leaf.
paragraphs.zh: 规划本身是一种有效的 FAOP 动作：一个规划叶节点携带来自效果签名（第 3.1 节）的效果标签 op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}}，并通过选择与组合已注册的现有 FAOP，或生成一个新的主体，来产生一个 FAOP。 因此，规划器是一种普通的 FAOP，其主体包含一个规划叶节点。

sents.en: Planning is itself a valid FAOP action: a planning leaf carries the effect label op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}} from the effect signature (Section 3.1 ) and produces a FAOP either by selecting and composing existing registered FAOPs, or by generating a new body.
sents.zh: 规划本身是一种有效的 FAOP 动作：一个规划叶节点携带来自效果签名（第 3.1 节）的效果标签 op plan \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{plan}}，并通过选择与组合已注册的现有 FAOP，或生成一个新的主体，来产生一个 FAOP。

sents.en: A planner is therefore an ordinary FAOP whose body contains a planning leaf.
sents.zh: 因此，规划器是一种普通的 FAOP，其主体包含一个规划叶节点。

paragraphs.en: Writing preds ⁡ ( F ) \operatorname{preds}(F) for the 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} and 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} predicates of F F , the level λ ⁡ ( F ) \lambda(F) is defined as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 F 的 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 和 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 谓词，定义其 preds ⁡ ( F ) \operatorname{preds}(F)，则层级 λ ⁡ ( F ) \lambda(F) 如下。

paragraphs.en: Level 0 (no AI): ∀ ℓ ∈ leaves ⁡ ( F ) : Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \forall\ell\in\operatorname{leaves}(F):\operatorname{Det}(\ell) and ∀ p ∈ preds ⁡ ( F ) : Comp ⁡ ( p ) \forall p\in\operatorname{preds}(F):\operatorname{Comp}(p) . No model is invoked anywhere.
paragraphs.zh: 第 0 级（无 AI）：∀ ℓ ∈ leaves ⁡ ( F ) : Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \forall\ell\in\operatorname{leaves}(F):\operatorname{Det}(\ell) 且 ∀ p ∈ preds ⁡ ( F ) : Comp ⁡ ( p ) \forall p\in\operatorname{preds}(F):\operatorname{Comp}(p) 。 任何地方都没有调用模型。

sents.en: Level 0 (no AI): ∀ ℓ ∈ leaves ⁡ ( F ) : Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \forall\ell\in\operatorname{leaves}(F):\operatorname{Det}(\ell) and ∀ p ∈ preds ⁡ ( F ) : Comp ⁡ ( p ) \forall p\in\operatorname{preds}(F):\operatorname{Comp}(p) .
sents.zh: 第 0 级（无 AI）：∀ ℓ ∈ leaves ⁡ ( F ) : Det ⁡ ( ℓ ) \forall\ell\in\operatorname{leaves}(F):\operatorname{Det}(\ell) 且 ∀ p ∈ preds ⁡ ( F ) : Comp ⁡ ( p ) \forall p\in\operatorname{preds}(F):\operatorname{Comp}(p) 。

sents.en: No model is invoked anywhere.
sents.zh: 任何地方都没有调用模型。

paragraphs.en: Level 1 (AI agent): some leaf is non-deterministic ( op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} ), but every branch and loop condition is still a computable boolean ( Comp \operatorname{Comp} ); the model may produce a value a condition later tests, but it does not select or generate which FAOPs run.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 级（AI 智能体）：某个叶节点是非确定性的（ op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} ），但每个分支和循环条件仍然是一个可计算的布尔值（ Comp \operatorname{Comp} ）；该模型可能会产生一个值，供后续的条件判断使用，但它不会选择或生成要执行的 FAOP。

paragraphs.en: Level 2 (agentic AI, selector planner): F F contains a planning leaf that selects and composes only existing registered FAOPs; no unverified logic enters the system.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 级（智能体式人工智能，选择规划器）：F F 包含一个规划叶节点，该节点仅选择和组合已注册的 FAOP；任何未经验证的逻辑都不会进入系统。

paragraphs.en: Level 3 (agentic AI, generator planner): F F contains a planning leaf that generates a new body; the produced FAOP may execute only after it passes FNF-1 through FNF-4.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 级（智能体式人工智能，生成规划器）：F F 包含一个规划叶节点，用于生成新的主体；生成的 FAOP 只有在通过 FNF-1 至 FNF-4 之后才能执行。

paragraphs.en: A planner emits FAOPs that must themselves be normalized, so λ \lambda describes a tower: a Level-2 or Level-3 FAOP produces Level-0 or Level-1 bodies. This paper treats the planning leaf as atomic and assumes every selected or generated FAOP is normalized statically, before execution. The reflective case (FAOPs as first-class runtime values, a runtime body-evaluation primitive, and normalization performed on the fly with the compiler as the runtime guardrail) is left to future work (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 规划器会发出 FAOP，而这些 FAOP 本身也必须经过规范化，因此 λ \lambda 描述了一个层级结构：Level-2 或 Level-3 的 FAOP 会产生 Level-0 或 Level-1 的主体。 本文将规划叶节点视为原子单元，并假设每个被选中或生成的 FAOP 在执行前都会经过静态规范化处理。 反射性情形（即将 FAOP 作为一等运行时值，使用运行时主体求值原语，并由编译器在运行时动态执行规范化操作以提供保障）则留待未来研究（第 7 节）。

sents.en: A planner emits FAOPs that must themselves be normalized, so λ \lambda describes a tower: a Level-2 or Level-3 FAOP produces Level-0 or Level-1 bodies.
sents.zh: 规划器会发出 FAOP，而这些 FAOP 本身也必须经过规范化，因此 λ \lambda 描述了一个层级结构：Level-2 或 Level-3 的 FAOP 会产生 Level-0 或 Level-1 的主体。

sents.en: This paper treats the planning leaf as atomic and assumes every selected or generated FAOP is normalized statically, before execution.
sents.zh: 本文将规划叶节点视为原子单元，并假设每个被选中或生成的 FAOP 在执行前都会经过静态规范化处理。

sents.en: The reflective case (FAOPs as first-class runtime values, a runtime body-evaluation primitive, and normalization performed on the fly with the compiler as the runtime guardrail) is left to future work (Section 7 ).
sents.zh: 反射性情形（即将 FAOP 作为一等运行时值，使用运行时主体求值原语，并由编译器在运行时动态执行规范化操作以提供保障）则留待未来研究（第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: The running example is Level 1: one leaf calls a model to summarize account activity, while every other leaf and predicate is deterministic (Appendix A.12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 运行示例是第 1 级：一个叶节点调用模型来总结账户活动，而其他所有叶节点和谓词都是确定性的（附录 A.12）。

paragraphs.en: Proving a lower level is a benefit in itself: every leaf shown deterministic bypasses the model, so a body with only a few op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} leaves runs mostly with no token cost, no model latency, and full reproducibility (Section 3.1 ). The level also drives governance: recorded in the FAOP’s signature (Section 3.8 ), it tells a model-risk review whether a system is a deterministic tool, an LLM-assisted tool with human oversight, or a runtime planner requiring the strongest controls.
paragraphs.zh: 证明存在更低的层级本身即是一项优势：每个被证明是确定性的叶节点都能绕过模型，因此一个仅包含少数 op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} 叶节点的主体，在运行时几乎不产生任何标记成本或模型延迟，并且完全可重复（第 3.1 节）。 该层级也决定了治理方式：它被记录在 FAOP 的签名中（第 3.8 节），用于向模型风险评估人员说明一个系统究竟是一个确定性工具、一个由人类监督的 LLM 辅助工具，还是一个需要最强控制措施的运行时规划器。

sents.en: Proving a lower level is a benefit in itself: every leaf shown deterministic bypasses the model, so a body with only a few op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} leaves runs mostly with no token cost, no model latency, and full reproducibility (Section 3.1 ).
sents.zh: 证明存在更低的层级本身即是一项优势：每个被证明是确定性的叶节点都能绕过模型，因此一个仅包含少数 op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} 叶节点的主体，在运行时几乎不产生任何标记成本或模型延迟，并且完全可重复（第 3.1 节）。

sents.en: The level also drives governance: recorded in the FAOP’s signature (Section 3.8 ), it tells a model-risk review whether a system is a deterministic tool, an LLM-assisted tool with human oversight, or a runtime planner requiring the strongest controls.
sents.zh: 该层级也决定了治理方式：它被记录在 FAOP 的签名中（第 3.8 节），用于向模型风险评估人员说明一个系统究竟是一个确定性工具、一个由人类监督的 LLM 辅助工具，还是一个需要最强控制措施的运行时规划器。

paragraphs.en: We expect the vast majority of production workflows, particularly in regulated domains such as finance, to lie at Levels 0 and 1, where the body is fixed and auditable and execution must follow the specification exactly. Level 2 selectors are plausible but uncommon (at most a single organization-wide planner that assembles workflows from the verified registry), and Level 3 generators, which synthesize new bodies at runtime, are rare to non-existent in settings where no execution error is tolerated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们预计，绝大多数生产工作流程，尤其是在金融等受监管的领域，将处于第 0 级和第 1 级：此时“主体”是固定且可审计的，执行必须严格遵循规范。 第 2 级的选择器虽然合理但并不常见（最多只有一个覆盖整个组织的规划器，用于从已验证的注册表中组装工作流程）；而在任何不允许执行错误的场景中，能够在运行时合成新“主体”的第 3 级生成器则极为罕见，甚至根本不存在。

sents.en: We expect the vast majority of production workflows, particularly in regulated domains such as finance, to lie at Levels 0 and 1, where the body is fixed and auditable and execution must follow the specification exactly.
sents.zh: 我们预计，绝大多数生产工作流程，尤其是在金融等受监管的领域，将处于第 0 级和第 1 级：此时“主体”是固定且可审计的，执行必须严格遵循规范。

sents.en: Level 2 selectors are plausible but uncommon (at most a single organization-wide planner that assembles workflows from the verified registry), and Level 3 generators, which synthesize new bodies at runtime, are rare to non-existent in settings where no execution error is tolerated.
sents.zh: 第 2 级的选择器虽然合理但并不常见（最多只有一个覆盖整个组织的规划器，用于从已验证的注册表中组装工作流程）；而在任何不允许执行错误的场景中，能够在运行时合成新“主体”的第 3 级生成器则极为罕见，甚至根本不存在。

paragraphs.en: Every compiled FAOP carries a signature : a compact, compiler-computed summary of what that FAOP has been shown to satisfy, written as the triple ( k , E , λ ) (k,E,\lambda) :
paragraphs.zh: 每个编译后的 FAOP 都携带一个签名：一个由编译器计算出的简洁摘要，用于说明该 FAOP 已被证明满足的条件，表示为三元组 ( k , E , λ ) (k,E,\lambda)：

paragraphs.en: k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } k\in\{0,1,2,3,4\} is the highest normal form the FAOP satisfies; k = 3 k=3 , for instance, means it meets FNF-1 through FNF-3 but not FNF-4.
paragraphs.zh: k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } k\in\{0,1,2,3,4\} 是 FAOP 满足的最高正常形式；例如，k = 3 k=3 表示它满足 FNF-1 到 FNF-3，但不满足 FNF-4。

paragraphs.en: E E is the set of extensions it satisfies, for example { + V , + O , + B } \{+V,+O,+B\} (Section 3.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: E E 是其所满足的扩展集合，例如 { + V , + O , + B } \{+V,+O,+B\}（第 3.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: λ ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } \lambda\in\{0,1,2,3\} is its AI architectural level (Section 3.7 ): whether the FAOP uses no model, a model as a tool, or a runtime planner.
paragraphs.zh: λ ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } \lambda\in\{0,1,2,3\} 是其人工智能架构层级（第 3.7 节）：即 FAOP 是否不使用模型、将模型作为工具使用，或采用运行时规划器。

paragraphs.en: The running example compiles to ( 4 , { + V , + O , + B } , 1 ) (4,\{+V,+O,+B\},1) (Appendix A.11 ).

The signature makes per-FAOP governance a check on the triple: an organization writes its deployment policy as a rule over ( k , E , λ ) (k,E,\lambda) : development might allow any k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 , while production might require k = 4 k=4 , + B ∈ E +B\in E , and λ ≤ 1 \lambda\leq 1 , reserving the strongest model-risk controls for planners ( λ ∈ { 2 , 3 } \lambda\in\{2,3\} ).
paragraphs.zh: 该签名使每个 FAOP 的治理成为对三元组的检查：一个组织将其部署策略写为对 ( k , E , λ ) (k,E,\lambda) 的规则：开发阶段可能允许任何 k ≥ 2 k\geq 2，而生产阶段可能需要 k = 4 k=4，+ B ∈ E +B\in E，且 λ ≤ 1 \lambda\leq 1，从而为规划者保留最强的模型风险控制（λ ∈ { 2 , 3 } \lambda\in\{2,3\}）。

paragraphs.en: The registry aggregates the signatures of all its FAOPs into a single Maturity Card : a portfolio view of the whole library (the distribution of normal-form levels k k , which extensions are satisfied where, and the spread of architectural levels λ \lambda ) that turns library-wide compliance into a schema-level, checkable property.
paragraphs.zh: 注册表将所有 FAOP 的签名汇总到一张单一的成熟度卡中：这是整个库的概览（包括标准形式级别 k k 的分布、哪些扩展在何处得到满足，以及架构级别 λ \lambda 的分布），从而将覆盖整个库的合规性转化为可在模式层面进行验证的属性。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 collects the consequences of the four normal forms and their extensions for a workflow library. Each row names a benefit, the behavior under FAOP that delivers it, and the responsible FAOP mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 汇总了四种范式及其扩展形式对工作流程库所产生的影响。 每一行都列出了一项益处、在 FAOP 下实现该益处的行为，以及负责此过程的 FAOP 机制。

sents.zh: 表 5 汇总了四种范式及其扩展形式对工作流程库所产生的影响。

sents.zh: 每一行都列出了一项益处、在 FAOP 下实现该益处的行为，以及负责此过程的 FAOP 机制。

paragraphs.en: A theory is only useful if its checks can be enforced on the artifacts an organization ships. The FAOP toolchain does this in two top-level pieces, shown in Figure 2 : SkillBase , the design-and-store side that checks and keeps FAOPs, and a separate executor that runs them. SkillBase is to an ad-hoc skill library what PostgreSQL is to a shared spreadsheet: it supplies the schema, constraints, and queryable metadata that turn a folder of files into a governed asset. In one line, SkillBase is an AOP management system . SkillBase has three components; the executor is the fourth part of the toolchain.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当理论的检查机制能够应用于组织交付的成果时，该理论才是有用的。 FAOP 工具链通过两个顶层组件实现这一点，如图 2 所示：SkillBase（负责设计和存储、检查并维护 FAOP 的设计与存储部分）以及一个独立的执行器（负责运行它们）。 SkillBase 对于临时技能库的作用，类似于 PostgreSQL 对于共享电子表格：它提供模式、约束和可查询的元数据，从而将文件夹中的文件转变为受管理的资产。 简而言之，SkillBase 是一个 AOP 管理系统。 SkillBase 包含三个组件；执行器是工具链的第四个部分。

sents.zh: 只有当理论的检查机制能够应用于组织交付的成果时，该理论才是有用的。

paragraphs.en: Vocabulary : the controlled catalog of canonical field, tool, and guardrail names. Every name in a FAOP must resolve here, so one workflow cannot call a field account_id while another calls the same field acct_no .
paragraphs.zh: 词汇表：受控的标准字段、工具和护栏名称目录。 FAOP 中的每个名称都必须在此处有明确对应，因此一个工作流不能调用名为 account_id 的字段，而另一个工作流却调用同一字段的名称为 acct_no。

sents.en: Vocabulary : the controlled catalog of canonical field, tool, and guardrail names.
sents.zh: 词汇表：受控的标准字段、工具和护栏名称目录。

paragraphs.en: Compiler : turns a source artifact into a checked, normalized FAOP. It parses the body, resolves names against the vocabulary, and runs the FNF-1–FNF-4 passes and the algebra and extension checks of Section 3 against the architect’s declarations (effect labels, scopes, and loop measures), flagging violations rather than inferring intent. It then computes the signature ( k , E , λ ) (k,E,\lambda) and emits the optimal, normalized blueprint consumed along either path below.
paragraphs.zh: 编译器：将源工件转换为经过验证和标准化的 FAOP。 它解析主体，根据词汇表解析名称，并针对架构师的声明（效果标签、作用域和循环度量）执行 FNF-1–FNF-4 阶段以及第 3 节中的代数和扩展检查，标记违规行为而非推断意图。 然后，它计算签名 ( k , E , λ )（k,E,\lambda），并输出沿下方任意路径使用的最优标准化蓝图。

sents.en: Compiler : turns a source artifact into a checked, normalized FAOP.
sents.zh: 编译器：将源工件转换为经过验证和标准化的 FAOP。

paragraphs.en: Registry : the index of record over the FAOP source files, which live in git: versioned FAOP bodies, the call DAG, a reverse-dependency index that answers impact queries when a shared FAOP changes, and the per-FAOP signatures the Maturity Card aggregates. The git files are the source of truth; the registry is a queryable index over them.
paragraphs.zh: 注册表：对 FAOP 源文件记录的索引，这些源文件位于 git 中：包括版本化的 FAOP 主体、调用 DAG、一个反向依赖索引（用于在共享 FAOP 变更时回答影响查询），以及 Maturity Card 汇总的每个 FAOP 的签名。 git 文件是权威来源；注册表是对这些文件的可查询索引。

sents.en: Registry : the index of record over the FAOP source files, which live in git: versioned FAOP bodies, the call DAG, a reverse-dependency index that answers impact queries when a shared FAOP changes, and the per-FAOP signatures the Maturity Card aggregates.

sents.zh: git 文件是权威来源；注册表是对这些文件的可查询索引。

paragraphs.en: FAOP executor : a separate runtime that runs a blueprint; it is the component that turns the compiled normal-form and extension guarantees into enforced runtime behavior. It dispatches each leaf by its effect symbol to the concrete tool, API, database, or model the leaf names, admits that call only when the scope Σ \Sigma permits it, handles interrupts and checkpoints, runs each FAOP invocation in its own state scope so that only its declared S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} crosses back to the caller, and runs proven-independent steps in parallel. Because it consumes only the blueprint, the executor can be built on an existing workflow engine rather than reimplementing one. The tools, APIs, databases, and models themselves lie outside the toolchain; the executor is the boundary that gates every call against Σ \Sigma .
paragraphs.zh: FAOP 执行器：一个独立的运行时环境，用于运行蓝图；它是将编译后的标准形式和扩展保证转化为强制执行运行时行为的组件。 它根据每个叶节点的效果符号将其分发到具体的工具、API、数据库或模型（这些是叶节点所命名的），仅当作用域 Σ \Sigma 允许时才会执行该调用，处理中断和检查点，在各自的状态作用域中运行每个 FAOP 调用，以确保只有其声明的 S_{\mathit{out}} 会返回给调用者，并且以并行方式运行相互独立的步骤。 由于它仅消耗蓝图，因此执行器可以基于现有的工作流引擎构建，而无需重新实现一个。 工具、API、数据库和模型本身位于工具链之外；执行器是边界组件，负责根据 Σ \Sigma 对每一次调用进行权限控制。

paragraphs.en: The theory fixes what a FAOP means, not how a runtime executes it, so the executor admits a range of implementations. At the simplest end, a single generic agent such as a ReAct loop [ 4 ] can be handed the whole FAOP and its tool list and left to carry out the workflow as free-form reasoning; this is trivial to build but recovers none of the guarantees, because the model, not the declared structure, decides control flow and tool access. To enforce the normal-form and extension guarantees at runtime, our executor instead interprets the body structurally.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论界定了 FAOP 的含义，而非运行时如何执行它，因此执行器允许多种实现方式。 在最简单的情况下，可以将整个 FAOP 及其工具列表交给一个通用智能体（例如 ReAct 循环 [4]），然后让它以自由形式推理的方式执行工作流程；这种实现虽然易于构建，但无法恢复任何保证，因为控制流和工具访问是由模型而非声明的结构决定的。 为了在运行时强制执行标准形式和扩展性保证，我们的执行器转而对主体进行结构化解释。

sents.zh: 该理论界定了 FAOP 的含义，而非运行时如何执行它，因此执行器允许多种实现方式。

paragraphs.en: The executor runs a FAOP by realizing the denotational semantics of Section 3.5 directly: it walks the body, threading the state record σ \sigma through each construct. A 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} runs its steps in order; an 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} evaluates its predicate and takes the matching arm; a 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} repeats its body until the predicate holds or the +V cap N max N_{\max} fires the exhaust handler; and a 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) opens a fresh frame for ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] , passing in only S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}} and merging back only its declared S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} . Each leaf is dispatched by its effect label to the bound tool, model, database, or in-process function, and admitted only if the scope Σ \Sigma permits it; proven-independent siblings run concurrently, with their disjoint output records merged by ⊎ \uplus . An ι \iota interrupt suspends the run with its query and resumes the continuation when the answer arrives, and a χ \chi checkpoint persists the running state so the workflow can resume from that point.
paragraphs.zh: 执行器通过直接实现第 3.5 节的指涉语义来运行一个 FAOP：它遍历主体，并将状态记录 σ \sigma 贯穿每个结构。 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} 按顺序执行其步骤；𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 评估其谓词并执行匹配分支；𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 重复其主体，直到谓词成立或 +V 上限 N max N_{\max} 触发结束处理程序；而 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) 则为 ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] 开辟一个新的帧，仅传入 S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}}，并仅合并其声明的 S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}}。 每个叶节点根据其效果标签被分发到绑定的工具、模型、数据库或进程内函数，且仅在作用域 Σ \Sigma 允许的情况下才被接纳；与证明无关的兄弟节点并发运行，其互斥的输出记录通过 ⊎ \uplus 合并。 一个 ι \iota 中断会携带其查询暂停执行，并在答案到达时恢复后续执行；而一个 χ \chi 检查点则会持久化当前运行状态，使工作流程能够从该点重新开始。

sents.en: The executor runs a FAOP by realizing the denotational semantics of Section 3.5 directly: it walks the body, threading the state record σ \sigma through each construct.

sents.en: A 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} runs its steps in order; an 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} evaluates its predicate and takes the matching arm; a 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} repeats its body until the predicate holds or the +V cap N max N_{\max} fires the exhaust handler; and a 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) opens a fresh frame for ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] , passing in only S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}} and merging back only its declared S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}} .
sents.zh: 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} 按顺序执行其步骤；𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} 评估其谓词并执行匹配分支；𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} 重复其主体，直到谓词成立或 +V 上限 N max N_{\max} 触发结束处理程序；而 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) 则为 ℛ ⁡ [ id ] \mathcal{R}[\text{id}] 开辟一个新的帧，仅传入 S 𝑖𝑛 S_{\mathit{in}}，并仅合并其声明的 S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 S_{\mathit{out}}。

sents.zh: 每个叶节点根据其效果标签被分发到绑定的工具、模型、数据库或进程内函数，且仅在作用域 Σ \Sigma 允许的情况下才被接纳；与证明无关的兄弟节点并发运行，其互斥的输出记录通过 ⊎ \uplus 合并。

sents.en: An ι \iota interrupt suspends the run with its query and resumes the continuation when the answer arrives, and a χ \chi checkpoint persists the running state so the workflow can resume from that point.
sents.zh: 一个 ι \iota 中断会携带其查询暂停执行，并在答案到达时恢复后续执行；而一个 χ \chi 检查点则会持久化当前运行状态，使工作流程能够从该点重新开始。

paragraphs.en: Compilation produces a single optimal, self-contained blueprint : the full FAOP (typed schemas, effect labels, scope, extensions, the normalized call DAG, every FAOP it transitively calls, and the vocabulary) stored in the registry alongside the discovery metadata ( n , d , S 𝑖𝑛 , S 𝑜𝑢𝑡 ) (n,d,S_{\mathit{in}},S_{\mathit{out}}) and the signature, so a consumer needs nothing else to run it. The same blueprint feeds both paths. A FAOP-aware executor consumes it directly, materializing it into a runnable graph and enforcing every normal-form guarantee and declared extension at runtime. For any other executor (a runtime that is not FAOP-aware), an adapter converts the same blueprint into an AOP in that executor’s own format, so an existing runtime can run the normalized workflow unchanged. The adapted AOP keeps the design-time benefits (explicit typed steps, canonical composites, and a clean description for discovery) and keeps the runtime guarantees, chiefly scope confinement (FNF-4) and effect-based LLM bypass, to the extent that the target executor can enforce them. The blueprint is thus the single compiled artifact: the FAOP-aware path runs it with full guarantees, while the adapter path may trade some of them for backward compatibility. Appendix A.14 exports the running example both ways.
paragraphs.zh: 编译过程会生成一个单一的最优、自包含的蓝图：完整的 FAOP（类型化模式、效果标签、作用域、扩展、归一化的调用 DAG、其所有间接调用的 FAOP 以及词汇表），该蓝图会与发现元数据（n, d, S_in, S_out）（n,d,S_{\mathit{in}},S_{\mathit{out}}）和签名一同存储在注册表中，因此消费者无需任何其他内容即可运行它。 同一份蓝图会供给两条路径使用。 支持 FAOP 的执行器可直接消费该蓝图，将其实例化为可运行的图，并在运行时强制执行所有正常形式保证和声明的扩展。 对于任何其他执行器（即不支持 FAOP 的运行环境），适配器会将同一蓝图转换为该执行器自身格式下的 AOP，从而使现有运行环境能够无变更地运行归一化的工作流。 转换后的 AOP 保留了设计时的优势（显式的类型化步骤、规范化的组合以及用于发现的清晰描述），并保留了运行时保证，尤其是作用域限制（FNF-4）和基于效果的 LLM 绕过机制，具体取决于目标执行器能否强制执行这些保证。 因此，该蓝图是唯一的编译产物：支持 FAOP 的路径会以其完整保证运行它，而适配器路径则可能为了向后兼容性而牺牲其中部分保证。 附录 A.14 以两种方式导出了该运行示例。

paragraphs.en: FAOP defines a small domain-specific language, playing the role for agent workflows that SQL plays for relational data: a deliberately restricted language that a system can check and optimize. The grammar of Section 2.3 is its syntax; the effect, type, and scope checks of FNF-1, FNF-2, and FNF-4 (with +V and +B) are its static semantics; the algebra of Section 3.5 is its equational theory; SkillBase’s compiler checks and normalizes its programs; and the FAOP executor is its reference runtime.
paragraphs.zh: FAOP 定义了一种小型领域特定语言，在智能体工作流中扮演着 SQL 在关系数据中所扮演的角色：这是一种经过刻意限制的语言，系统可以对其进行验证和优化。 第 2.3 节的文法是其语法；FNF-1、FNF-2 和 FNF-4（含 +V 和 +B）的效果、类型和作用域检查构成了其静态语义；第 3.5 节的代数是其等式理论；SkillBase 的编译器会验证并规范化其程序；而 FAOP 执行器则是其参考运行时。

paragraphs.en: The compiler does not do everything on its own. The Skill Architect (the DBA of the agentic era, Section 2 ) supplies the declarations the compiler checks and makes the judgments the rules leave open: authoring or reviewing the source artifact; declaring each leaf’s effect label (FNF-1) and scope (FNF-4) and any loop measure (+V), which the compiler verifies but does not infer; choosing which sub-workflows become canonical FAOPs under Π comp \Pi_{\mathrm{comp}} (FNF-3); curating vocabulary terms; and setting the deployment policy over FAOP signatures. The compiler enforces the mechanical rules; the architect makes the decisions the rules cannot. We describe the Skill Architect as a person, but the role is not intrinsically human: the same steps (drafting a source artifact, lifting it into the grammar, and proposing effect labels, scopes, and loop measures for the compiler to check) can be carried out by an AI agent, the generator case of Level 3 (Section 3.7 ) and the direction the auto-authoring skill literature already points to [ 22 , 12 , 13 , 23 ] . This paper keeps the process deterministic and architect-reviewed; automating more of it is future work (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 编译器并非独立完成所有工作。 技能架构师（智能体时代的 DBA，见第 2 节）负责提供编译器需要检查的声明，并做出规则未明确界定的判断：编写或审查源工件；声明每个叶节点的效果标签（FNF-1）、作用域（FNF-4）以及任何循环度量（+V），这些内容需由编译器验证而非推断；选择哪些子工作流在 Π comp \Pi_{\mathrm{comp}} 下成为标准的 FAOP（FNF-3）；管理词汇术语；以及设定针对 FAOP 签名的部署策略。 编译器执行机械性规则；架构师则做出规则无法做出的决策。 我们将技能架构师描述为一个人，但该角色本身并非必须由人类担任：相同的步骤（起草源工件、将其纳入语法体系，并为编译器提供效果标签、作用域和循环度量以供检查）也可以由 AI 智能体完成，即第 3.7 节中第 3 级的生成器情形，这也是自动编写技能文献 [22, 12, 13, 23] 已指明的方向。 本文保持该过程的确定性并由架构师进行审查；进一步自动化其中的更多环节是未来的工作（见第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: This paper is intentionally theory-first: it establishes the formalism, the four normal forms, the FAOP algebra, and the toolchain, and defers a full empirical study. The worked normalization of Appendix A serves as the end-to-end demonstration.
paragraphs.zh: 本文有意采用“理论优先”的路线：它确立了形式体系、四种范式、FAOP代数以及工具链，并将完整的实证研究留待后续进行。 附录A中的规范化过程演示了端到端的完整实现。

sents.zh: 附录A中的规范化过程演示了端到端的完整实现。

paragraphs.en: ReAct [ 4 ] established the pattern of LLM agents interleaving reasoning with tool calls, and HuggingGPT [ 24 ] extended it by selecting tools from a registry via semantic description matching. More recent systems standardize the skill and tool interface itself: OctoTools [ 2 ] formalizes tool cards (name, description, I/O schema, and constraints) with a planner–executor architecture that outperforms AutoGen, GPT-Functions, and LangChain by up to 10.6% on tool-use benchmarks, while orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel [ 25 ] , LangChain [ 26 ] , AutoGen [ 27 ] , CrewAI [ 28 ] , Google A2A [ 29 ] , and Anthropic MCP [ 30 ] converge on a common {name, description, inputSchema, outputSchema} contract. Around these frameworks the skill abstraction has grown into a studied infrastructure layer in its own right, surveyed across its lifecycle (representation, acquisition, retrieval, and evolution [ 31 ] ) and extended beyond text to multimodal visual skills [ 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: ReAct [ 4 ] 确立了 LLM 智能体将推理与工具调用交替使用的模式，而 HuggingGPT [ 24 ] 则通过基于语义描述匹配从工具库中选择工具，对该模式进行了扩展。 较新的系统对技能与工具接口本身进行了标准化：OctoTools [ 2 ] 通过规划器–执行器架构将工具卡（名称、描述、输入/输出模式及约束条件）形式化，在工具使用基准测试中的表现比 AutoGen、GPT-Functions 和 LangChain 高出最多 10.6%；而 Semantic Kernel [ 25 ]、LangChain [ 26 ]、AutoGen [ 27 ]、CrewAI [ 28 ]、Google A2A [ 29 ] 和 Anthropic MCP [ 30 ] 等编排框架则统一采用了共同的 {name, description, inputSchema, outputSchema} 协议。 围绕这些框架，技能抽象已发展成为一个独立的研究性基础设施层，其整个生命周期（表示、获取、检索与演化 [ 31 ]）均得到了系统研究，并且其应用已从文本扩展到了多模态视觉技能 [ 32 ]。

paragraphs.en: Yet most of this work defines, standardizes, and measures the atoms of agent systems, not a theory for reshaping the library they form. FAOP supplies that theory: it treats each skill as a typed function within a formal algebra, applies progressive normal forms for incremental guarantees, and provides a compiler that catches composition errors before deployment. It is also modality-agnostic, since it normalizes a workflow’s body regardless of what each leaf computes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这项工作的绝大部分内容只是对智能体系统的构成要素进行了定义、标准化和衡量，并未提出一种重塑这些要素所构成的“图书馆”的理论。 FAOP 提供了这样的理论：它将每项技能视为形式代数中的一个带类型函数，通过逐步应用规范形式来实现渐进式保障，并提供一个能在部署前捕获组合错误的编译器。 它还具有模态无关性，因为它会规范化工作流程的主体，而无论每个叶子节点具体执行何种计算。

paragraphs.en: A close neighbor is GraSP [ 33 ] , which inserts a compilation layer between skill retrieval and execution: it compiles the skills retrieved for a task into a typed DAG with precondition–effect edges, verifies nodes at runtime, and repairs failures through a five-operator local-repair algebra. GraSP and FAOP address different problems: GraSP compiles a single task’s retrieved skills for runtime orchestration performance, its algebra patching a failing execution graph in place; FAOP normalizes the whole library at design time: progressive normal forms, an equational algebra of semantics-preserving rewrites , compile-time scope isolation, and registry-level impact analysis, none of which GraSP provides. Their typing is where they meet: GraSP’s precondition–effect edges are the runtime counterpart of FNF-2, so a GraSP-style executor could run a workflow FAOP has already normalized and scoped.
paragraphs.zh: 一个密切相关的邻近方法是 GraSP [ 33 ]，它在技能检索与执行之间插入了一个编译层：它将任务中检索到的技能编译成一个带有预条件–效果边的类型化 DAG，在运行时验证节点，并通过一种包含五个算子的局部修复代数来修复故障。 GraSP 和 FAOP 解决的是不同的问题：GraSP 为单个任务的检索技能进行编译，以优化运行时的编排性能，其代数能够在原地修补出故障的执行图；而 FAOP 则在设计时对整个库进行规范化：包括渐进式规范形式、语义保持重写的等式代数、编译时的作用域隔离以及注册表级别的影響分析——这些 GraSP 均未提供。 它们的类型系统则是交汇之处：GraSP 的预条件–效果边是 FNF-2 在运行时的对应物，因此一个 GraSP 风格的执行器可以运行 FAOP 已经进行了规范化和作用域隔离的工作流。

sents.en: GraSP and FAOP address different problems: GraSP compiles a single task’s retrieved skills for runtime orchestration performance, its algebra patching a failing execution graph in place; FAOP normalizes the whole library at design time: progressive normal forms, an equational algebra of semantics-preserving rewrites , compile-time scope isolation, and registry-level impact analysis, none of which GraSP provides.
sents.zh: GraSP 和 FAOP 解决的是不同的问题：GraSP 为单个任务的检索技能进行编译，以优化运行时的编排性能，其代数能够在原地修补出故障的执行图；而 FAOP 则在设计时对整个库进行规范化：包括渐进式规范形式、语义保持重写的等式代数、编译时的作用域隔离以及注册表级别的影響分析——这些 GraSP 均未提供。

sents.en: Their typing is where they meet: GraSP’s precondition–effect edges are the runtime counterpart of FNF-2, so a GraSP-style executor could run a workflow FAOP has already normalized and scoped.
sents.zh: 它们的类型系统则是交汇之处：GraSP 的预条件–效果边是 FNF-2 在运行时的对应物，因此一个 GraSP 风格的执行器可以运行 FAOP 已经进行了规范化和作用域隔离的工作流。

paragraphs.en: Another close neighbor is Agentics 2.0 [ 5 ] , which models each LLM call as a typed function over records, composes such functions under identity, associative composition, and Map-Reduce, and validates their outputs at run time. FAOP shares this typed-function view, but its algebra adds commutativity, branch distribution, and fold/unfold, and it normalizes, scopes, and checks a whole library before deployment rather than one program at run time.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个密切相关的邻近项目是 Agentics 2.0 [ 5 ]，它将每次 LLM 调用建模为对记录执行类型化操作的功能，在恒等性、结合性组合以及 Map-Reduce 框架下组合这些功能，并在运行时验证其输出。 FAOP 也采用了这种类型化功能的视角，但其代数体系增加了交换性、分支分布以及折叠/展开机制，并且在部署前会对整个库进行归一化、作用域限定和检查，而不是像 Agentics 2.0 那样仅在运行时检查单个程序。

paragraphs.en: The foundation of modern agent workflows rests on prompt engineering advances. Wei et al. [ 34 ] showed that decomposing reasoning into intermediate steps dramatically improves LLM performance. Yao et al. [ 4 ] extended this by interleaving reasoning with tool-calling actions, creating the reason-act-observe loop that underlies most agent executors today. Schulhoff et al. [ 35 ] catalog 58 distinct prompting techniques, and Zhang et al. [ 36 ] trace the evolution from single-prompt reasoning to multi-step agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 现代智能体工作流的基础建立在提示工程技术的进步之上。Wei 等人 [ 34 ] 的研究表明，将推理过程分解为中间步骤能显著提升大语言模型的性能。Yao 等人 [ 4 ] 在此基础上进一步提出，将推理与工具调用动作交替执行，形成了当前大多数智能体执行器所依赖的“推理-行动-观察”循环。Schulhoff 等人 [ 35 ] 梳理总结了 58 种不同的提示技术，Zhang 等人 [ 36 ] 追溯了从单提示推理到多步骤智能体系统的演变过程。

paragraphs.en: A skill or AOP is, at its core, a prompt: a step-by-step operational prompt that guides an agent through a workflow. Prompt engineering techniques such as chain-of-thought [ 34 ] and few-shot prompting [ 37 ] improve the quality of each individual step. FAOP still uses prompt engineering at the step level; it does not replace it. What FAOP adds is the theory for managing large skill libraries, the problem that arises when an organization has hundreds of skills sharing common sub-procedures. Specifically, FAOP provides integrity across skills, scope isolation, and compile-time optimizations.
paragraphs.zh: 技能或 AOP 的核心其实是一个提示：一个分步操作提示，用于引导智能体完成工作流程。 提示工程技术，例如思维链 [34] 和少样本提示 [37]，能够提升每一步操作的质量。 FAOP 仍然在步骤层面使用提示工程；它并未取代该技术。 FAOP 所增加的是管理大型技能库的理论框架——当一个组织拥有数百个共享通用子流程的技能时，这一问题便会出现。 具体来说，FAOP 实现了跨技能的完整性、作用域隔离以及编译时的优化。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of work produces source workflows from natural-language inputs. AutoFlow [ 12 ] generates agent workflows as natural-language programs from task descriptions, refined by fine-tuning or in-context optimization. AFlow [ 13 ] searches the space of code-represented agentic workflows via Monte-Carlo Tree Search with execution feedback, achieving a 5.7% average improvement over strong baselines on six benchmarks and enabling smaller models to match or outperform GPT-4o on specific tasks at a fraction of the inference cost. Flow-of-Action [ 14 ] structures Site-Reliability-Engineering expertise as explicit SOPs, and synthesizes new ones when none exist, then constrains a multi-agent system to follow them, lifting Root-Cause-Analysis accuracy from 35.5% under ReAct to 64.0%. These pipelines produce the initial artifact (the natural-language or code-shaped workflow) but stop there: they do not typecheck it, do not deduplicate it against a shared registry, and do not confine its scope. FAOP consumes such an artifact as ℛ 0 \mathcal{R}_{0} (Section 3.1 ) and then runs the FNF-1–FNF-4 passes over it, so the generator supplies the raw material and FAOP supplies the normalization.
paragraphs.zh: 一项独立的工作流程从自然语言输入中生成源工作流程。 AutoFlow [ 12 ] 根据任务描述生成以自然语言编写的智能体工作流程，并通过微调或上下文优化进行完善。 AFlow [ 13 ] 通过蒙特卡洛树搜索结合执行反馈，在代码表示的智能体工作流程空间中进行搜索，在六个基准测试中相比强基线模型平均提升了 5.7%，并使得较小的模型在特定任务上能够与 GPT-4o 表现相当甚至更优，同时推理成本仅为其一小部分。 Flow-of-Action [ 14 ] 将站点可靠性工程的专业知识结构化为明确的 SOP，并在不存在相关 SOP 时合成新的 SOP，然后约束多智能体系统遵循这些 SOP，从而将根本原因分析的准确率从 ReAct 方法下的 35.5% 提升至 64.0%。 这些流程会生成初始产物（以自然语言或代码形式表示的工作流程），但仅止于此：它们不会进行类型检查，也不会与共享注册表进行去重处理，更不会限制其作用范围。 FAOP 将此类产物作为 ℛ 0 \mathcal{R}_{0}（第 3.1 节）输入，然后对其执行 FNF-1–FNF-4 处理步骤，因此生成器提供原始材料，而 FAOP 负责标准化处理。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, no prior work directly addresses the problem FAOP solves: normalizing skill libraries with progressive normal forms and a FAOP algebra. Recent systematizations of the skill layer in fact call for exactly this ( verifiable and certifiable skills [ 1 , 18 ] ), naming the gap FAOP fills. Several recent works, grouped below, tackle adjacent problems.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，尚无先前的研究直接解决 FAOP 所解决的问题：通过渐进式规范形式和 FAOP 代数对技能库进行标准化。 事实上，近期对技能层的系统化研究恰恰需要这一点（可验证且可认证的技能 [ 1 , 18 ]），这也指出了 FAOP 所填补的空白。 下面汇总的几项近期研究，均致力于解决相关的问题。

sents.en: To our knowledge, no prior work directly addresses the problem FAOP solves: normalizing skill libraries with progressive normal forms and a FAOP algebra.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，尚无先前的研究直接解决 FAOP 所解决的问题：通过渐进式规范形式和 FAOP 代数对技能库进行标准化。

sents.en: Recent systematizations of the skill layer in fact call for exactly this ( verifiable and certifiable skills [ 1 , 18 ] ), naming the gap FAOP fills.
sents.zh: 事实上，近期对技能层的系统化研究恰恰需要这一点（可验证且可认证的技能 [ 1 , 18 ]），这也指出了 FAOP 所填补的空白。

sents.en: Several recent works, grouped below, tackle adjacent problems.
sents.zh: 下面汇总的几项近期研究，均致力于解决相关的问题。

paragraphs.en: Odersky et al. [ 38 ] show that capability tracking in the type system can enforce tool-access restrictions at compile time rather than runtime, directly validating FAOP’s scope-isolation design. Progent [ 39 ] enforces per-step tool permissions through a runtime policy engine, MiniScope [ 40 ] reconstructs least-privilege permission hierarchies over tool calls (arguing that LLM-in-the-loop confinement lacks rigorous guarantees), Prompt Flow Integrity [ 41 ] adds agent isolation and guardrails against privilege escalation, and a policy algebra for agentic execution [ 42 ] composes security profiles, tool sets, and budgets so that authority can only narrow across delegation. These enforce scope at runtime; FAOP’s scope monotonicity, under which no step can exceed its parent’s scope, moves the same guarantee to compile time. A recent skill-security survey likewise calls for capability-based permission governance of skills [ 8 ] , exactly the control FNF-4 provides at compile time.
paragraphs.zh: Odersky 等人 [ 38 ] 指出，类型系统中的能力跟踪可以在编译时而非运行时强制执行工具访问限制，从而直接验证了 FAOP 的作用域隔离设计。 Progent [ 39 ] 通过运行时策略引擎强制每一步的工具权限；MiniScope [ 40 ] 在工具调用中重建最小权限的权限层次结构（认为“循环内 LLM”的约束缺乏严格的保证）；Prompt Flow Integrity [ 41 ] 增加了智能体隔离和防止权限提升的安全护栏；而用于智能体执行的政策代数 [ 42 ] 则组合了安全配置文件、工具集和预算，使得权限在委托过程中只能逐步缩小。 这些方法在运行时强制执行作用域限制；而 FAOP 的作用域单调性——即任何步骤都不能超出其父步骤的作用域——将同样的保证提前到了编译时。 最近一项关于技能安全的研究同样呼吁对技能实施基于能力的权限治理 [ 8 ]，而这正是 FNF-4 在编译时提供的控制机制。

sents.en: Odersky et al.
sents.zh: Odersky 等人

paragraphs.en: λ A \lambda_{A} [ 6 ] defines a typed lambda calculus for agent composition, whose pipeline composition satisfies identity and associativity, with Coq-mechanized type-safety and termination proofs; its audit of 835 real GitHub agent configurations found 94.1% structurally incomplete, confirming that these defects are endemic rather than rare. Agentproof [ 43 ] extracts graph models from framework code and statically checks reachability and dead-end absence, and Lean4Agent [ 44 ] uses Lean 4 dependent types for full workflow verification, reporting about 12% higher task success for verified workflows. GraphFlow [ 45 ] requires the pre- and postcondition contracts of acyclic, sequential workflow diagrams to be proof-checked before admission to a shared library, a verification layer its authors describe as specified and in active development. FAOP shares these goals but trades heavyweight theorem proving for a lightweight compiler that runs on the specification before code exists, adding normal forms for progressive adoption and rewrite laws beyond identity and associativity for safe refactoring.
paragraphs.zh: λ A \lambda_{A} [ 6 ] 定义了一种用于智能体组合的类型化λ演算，其管道组合满足恒等性和结合性，并具备通过Coq机制实现的安全性及终止性证明；对835个真实GitHub智能体配置进行的审计发现，其中94.1%存在结构性不完整问题，证实这些缺陷是普遍存在的，而非罕见现象。 Agentproof [ 43 ] 从框架代码中提取图模型，并静态检查可达性和死结的缺失情况；而Lean4Agent [ 44 ] 则利用Lean 4的依赖类型对完整的工作流进行验证，报告称经过验证的工作流任务成功率提升了约12%。 GraphFlow [ 45 ] 要求无环、顺序工作流图的预条件和后条件合同在纳入共享库前必须通过证明检查；其作者将这一验证层描述为已明确规范且正在积极开发中。 FAOP共享这些目标，但用一种轻量级编译器替代了重型定理证明：该编译器在代码生成前即可对规范进行运行，并增加了渐进式采用的标准形式以及超越恒等性和结合性的重写法则，以实现安全的重构。

paragraphs.en: Declarative Policy Compilation [ 46 ] compiles one DSL specification into multiple deployment artifacts with compile-time verification: close to FAOP’s pipeline, but without normal forms or algebraic optimization. AgentSpec [ 47 ] enforces runtime safety constraints structured as triggers, predicates, and enforcement mechanisms, and Agent Behavioral Contracts [ 48 ] give four-tuple contracts ( P , I , G , R ) (P,I,G,R) with sufficient conditions for safe composition. FAOP formalizes the same compositionality question as equational laws over workflow bodies and, unlike these, stores the result in a normalized registry whose reverse-dependency index makes change-impact a compile-time query.

paragraphs.en: FNF-1’s “at most one mutating effect per leaf” condition (Section 3.1 ) draws on a long programming-languages tradition. Type-and-effect systems, from Lucassen and Gifford [ 49 ] to Marino and Millstein’s generic account [ 50 ] , extend a function’s type with a summary of the effects it performs (reads, writes, allocations) over typed regions; Wadler’s monadic style [ 51 ] obtains the same pure/impure separation by threading effects through a monad. These systems are descriptive : given a program, they report the effects it already has, but they do not dictate how the program should be decomposed into effectful steps.
paragraphs.zh: FNF-1 的“每个叶节点最多一个突变效应”条件（第 3.1 节）借鉴了编程语言领域的长期传统。 类型与效应系统，从 Lucassen 和 Gifford [49] 到 Marino 和 Millstein 的通用理论 [50]，通过为函数的类型附加其在有类型约束的区域中执行的操作（读取、写入、分配）的摘要来扩展该函数；Wadler 的单子风格 [51] 则通过将效应贯穿一个单子来实现同样的纯/不纯分离。 这些系统具有描述性：给定一个程序，它们会报告该程序已有的效应，但不会规定该程序应如何分解为带有效应的步骤。

sents.en: FNF-1’s “at most one mutating effect per leaf” condition (Section 3.1 ) draws on a long programming-languages tradition.
sents.zh: FNF-1 的“每个叶节点最多一个突变效应”条件（第 3.1 节）借鉴了编程语言领域的长期传统。

sents.en: These systems are descriptive : given a program, they report the effects it already has, but they do not dictate how the program should be decomposed into effectful steps.
sents.zh: 这些系统具有描述性：给定一个程序，它们会报告该程序已有的效应，但不会规定该程序应如何分解为带有效应的步骤。

paragraphs.en: FAOP inverts that relationship. It does not infer effects from code; the architect structures the workflow so that each leaf carries exactly one effect symbol from a finite signature Σ E \Sigma_{E} , formalized as the generic-effect operations of Plotkin and Power [ 15 , 52 ] . The one-effect-per-leaf rule is therefore a design constraint on the workflow, checked against the architect’s declaration rather than inferred from source. The classical effect analyzes still help: they can flag leaves that likely carry more than one effect and so tighten the declared counts, serving as architect aids rather than as the checker itself.
paragraphs.zh: FAOP 反转了这种关系。 它不会从代码中推断出效应；架构师会设计工作流程，使得每个叶子节点恰好携带来自有限符号集 Σ E \Sigma_{E} 的一个效应符号，该符号集被形式化为 Plotkin 和 Power [15, 52] 提出的通用效应操作。 因此，“每个叶子节点仅有一个效应”的规则是对工作流程的一项设计约束，需依据架构师的声明进行验证，而非从源代码中推断得出。 经典的效应分析工具仍然有其作用：它们可以标记出可能携带多个效应的叶子节点，从而收紧声明的效应数量，起到辅助架构师的作用，而非作为检查器本身。

paragraphs.en: FAOP also does more than validate declared structure: it normalizes that structure with the algebra of Section 3.5 to remove redundancy and expose parallelism, and stores the result in a registry with reverse-dependency indexing, so the impact of changing a shared step is a compile-time query: the organization-scale concern that the declarative-compilation and contract proposals above leave unaddressed.
paragraphs.zh: FAOP 不仅验证了声明的结构，还利用第 3.5 节中的代数对该结构进行规范化，以消除冗余并揭示并行性，然后将结果存储在一个具有反向依赖索引的注册表中，因此更改共享步骤所带来的影响可以在编译时通过查询确定：这正是上述声明式编译和合同提案未能解决的组织级问题。

paragraphs.en: Reflective planning. Levels 2 and 3 (Section 3.7 ) treat the planning leaf as atomic and assume any selected or generated FAOP is normalized statically, before execution. Lifting this to a reflective calculus (FAOPs as first-class runtime values, a runtime body-evaluation primitive, and normal-form checking performed on the fly with the compiler as the runtime guardrail) is the main open problem; it interacts with the completeness result (Section 2 ) and with termination (+V).
paragraphs.zh: 反思性规划。 第 2 级和第 3 级（第 3.7 节）将规划叶视为原子单元，并假设任何选定的或生成的 FAOP 在执行前都会经过静态归一化。 将其提升为一种反思性演算（即 FAOP 作为一等运行时值、运行时本体求值原语，以及由编译器作为运行时护栏在运行时即时执行的标准形式检查）是当前的主要开放问题；该问题与完备性结果（第 2 节）和终止性（+V）存在相互作用。

paragraphs.en: Tooling and evaluation. The compiler, registry, executor, and SkillBase (Section 4 ) and the empirical study (Section 5 ) are described but not yet reported. A corpus analysis of real skill libraries (violation rates per normal form, the distribution of architectural levels, and measured optimization gains) remains to be carried out.
paragraphs.zh: 工具与评估。 编译器、注册表、执行器和 SkillBase（第 4 节）以及实证研究（第 5 节）已有描述，但尚未报告结果。 对真实技能库的语料分析（每种标准形式的违规率、架构级别的分布以及测得的优化增益）仍有待开展。

sents.zh: 工具与评估。

paragraphs.en: Transactional atomicity. Agents that move money, send messages, or write to external systems need an all-or-nothing commit guarantee, so that a partial failure never leaves external systems half-updated. A transactional extension (+T) that confines external writes to a terminal commit and buffers internal state until then is important for production agents and is planned as near-term work.
paragraphs.zh: 事务原子性。 负责转移资金、发送消息或向外部系统写入数据的智能体需要“全有或全无”的提交保证，以确保部分故障不会导致外部系统处于半更新状态。 一种事务扩展（+T），它将外部写入操作限制在最终提交阶段，并在此前缓冲内部状态，这对生产环境中的智能体至关重要，且已计划作为近期工作实施。

sents.zh: 事务原子性。

paragraphs.en: Runtime decomposition. A FAOP’s typed call graph makes a previously intractable question answerable: which parts of a workflow should run in which runtime, when a large agent is split across runtimes for latency, cost, data residency, or autonomy level? A cut is cheap only where the dataflow crossing it is thin, so where to cut couples directly to the independence analysis (Definition 7 ): choosing these partitions is a promising new research area that the FAOP structure makes tractable.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时分解。 FAOP 的类型化调用图使得一个此前难以解决的问题变得可解：当一个大智能体因延迟、成本、数据驻留或自主性水平而被拆分成多个运行时运行时，工作流的哪些部分应该在哪个运行时中运行？ 只有在穿越该切分点的数据流较小时，切分才是低成本的，因此切分的位置直接关联到独立性分析（定义 7）：选择这些分区是一个有前景的新研究领域，而 FAOP 结构使其变得可解。

sents.en: Runtime decomposition.
sents.zh: 运行时分解。

paragraphs.en: At scale, as workflow libraries grow to thousands, three classes of defect emerge that current agent frameworks cannot answer: failures of integrity across a shared library, failures of isolation between steps and the tools and data they touch, and the absence of an algebra to safely refactor, optimize, bound, and govern whole workflow libraries. These are structurally the problems relational data faced before Codd, and prose-and-code skills have no theory to prevent them; that is what motivates FAOP.
paragraphs.zh: 当规模扩大、工作流库增长到数千个时，会出现三类当前智能体框架无法解决的问题：共享库中的完整性失效、步骤与其所接触的工具和数据之间的隔离性失效，以及缺乏一种能够安全地重构、优化、约束和管理整个工作流库的代数体系。 从结构上看，这些问题正是 Codd 之前关系数据所面临的问题，而纯文本与代码的技能缺乏能够防止这些问题的理论；这正是推动 FAOP 发展的动因。

paragraphs.en: We presented FAOP, a theory that applies the database-normalization paradigm to agent skills and AOPs: a typed functional core (Section 2 ), four progressive normal forms that eliminate opacity, missing-data errors, drift and silently non-terminating recursion, and privilege escalation (Section 3.1 –Section 3.4 ), a FAOP algebra of meaning-preserving rewrites (Section 3.5 ), orthogonal extensions for verification, optimization, and resource bounds (Section 3.6 ), and an architectural-level classification that tells an organization whether a use case needs AI and how it must be governed (Section 3.7 ). Together these turn an unstructured skill library into a registry a compiler can check, summarized per FAOP by its signature ( k , E , λ ) (k,E,\lambda) . Realized as SkillBase and a separate executor, FAOP is to AOPs what PostgreSQL is to data: a governed, queryable store with schemas, constraints, and integrity where there was only a folder of files. And because every FAOP is an AOP that one fixed executor runs, a new agent is authored rather than engineered: in our own deployment we observed new-agent development fall from weeks to hours.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FAOP，这是一种将数据库范式应用于智能体技能和 AOP 的理论：它包括一个带类型的函数核心（第 2 节）、四个渐进式范式，用于消除不透明度、缺失数据错误、漂移和静默非终止递归以及权限提升（第 3.1–3.4 节）、一种保持语义的 FAOP 代数重写系统（第 3.5 节）、用于验证、优化和资源限制的独立扩展（第 3.6 节），以及一个架构级分类体系，用于判断某个用例是否需要 AI 以及如何对其进行治理（第 3.7 节）。 这些要素共同将非结构化的技能库转化为编译器可以检查的注册表，每个 FAOP 通过其签名（k, E, λ）（k,E,\lambda）进行总结。 FAOP 以 SkillBase 和一个独立的执行器实现，其对 AOP 的意义类似于 PostgreSQL 对数据：它提供了一个受治理、可查询的存储系统，包含模式、约束和完整性，而此前这里只有一个文件文件夹。 并且由于每个 FAOP 都是一个由固定执行器运行的 AOP，因此新的智能体是通过编写而非工程实现的：在我们自己的部署中，我们观察到新智能体的开发时间从数周缩短到了数小时。

paragraphs.en: This appendix works one running example end to end: a monthly account-statement workflow. We use AOP terminology throughout, but the same procedure applies to any source artifact whose steps are defined to accomplish a task: an SOP, an AOP, or a framework skill.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录将完整演示一个运行示例：月度账户对账单工作流程。 全文均使用 AOP 术语，但同样的流程也适用于任何通过定义步骤来完成特定任务的源工件：无论是 SOP、AOP，还是框架技能。

sents.en: This appendix works one running example end to end: a monthly account-statement workflow.
sents.zh: 本附录将完整演示一个运行示例：月度账户对账单工作流程。

sents.en: We use AOP terminology throughout, but the same procedure applies to any source artifact whose steps are defined to accomplish a task: an SOP, an AOP, or a framework skill.
sents.zh: 全文均使用 AOP 术语，但同样的流程也适用于任何通过定义步骤来完成特定任务的源工件：无论是 SOP、AOP，还是框架技能。

paragraphs.en: The source artifact lists the steps needed to finish the task. The Skill Architect extracts those steps (by hand or with tool assistance) into two stores: a vocabulary of canonical names and a registry of FAOP tuples. Extraction rewrites each unit of prose as one of the constructors of the FAOP body language (the grammar of Section 2.3 ); this is the making steps explicit activity of FNF-1 (Section 3.1 ). A plain step becomes an action, ordered steps become a sequence 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq} , a conditional becomes a branch 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} , a repeated step becomes a loop 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} , a question put to a person becomes an interrupt ι \iota , a save point becomes a checkpoint χ \chi , and a reference to an already-registered procedure becomes a call 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 \mathit{call} . Each step of the source thus yields one FAOP. The leaves are then checked for atomicity (FNF-1), after which the compiler checks typing (FNF-2), canonical reuse (FNF-3), and scope confinement (FNF-4). Extensions (+V, +O, +B) and the signature close the example.
paragraphs.zh: 源工件列出了完成任务所需的步骤。 技能架构师将这些步骤（手动或使用工具辅助）提取到两个存储中：一个标准名称词汇表和一个 FAOP 元组注册表。 提取过程将每个文本单元重写为 FAOP 身体语言（第 2.3 节的语法）的构造子之一；这是 FNF-1（第 3.1 节）中使步骤显性化的活动。 一个普通步骤变为一个动作，有序步骤变为一个序列 𝑠𝑒𝑞 \mathit{seq}，条件变为一个分支 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if}，重复步骤变为一个循环 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop}，向某人提出的问题变为一个中断 ι \iota，保存点变为一个检查点 χ \chi，而对已注册程序的引用则变为一个调用 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 \mathit{call}。 因此，源中的每个步骤都会产生一个 FAOP。 随后会检查叶节点的原子性（FNF-1），之后编译器会检查类型正确性（FNF-2）、标准重用性（FNF-3）和作用域限制（FNF-4）。 扩展（+V、+O、+B）和签名完成了该示例。

paragraphs.en: Each registry entry is a FAOP tuple of Definition 1: the identity id , the name n n and description d d used for discovery, the body b b that performs the work (a primitive without sub-bodies for a leaf, or a composite body of sub-FAOPs for a composite), and the scope Σ = ⟨ 𝒯 , 𝒢 ⟩ \Sigma=\langle\mathcal{T},\mathcal{G}\rangle . In each tuple S_in names the fields the FAOP reads and S_out the fields it produces. Because the record only grows along a sequence (Convention 1 ), S_out lists only the new fields the FAOP adds; the record seen by the next step is the incoming state extended with them.
paragraphs.zh: 每个注册表条目都是定义 1 中的一个 FAOP 元组：用于发现的标识符 id、名称 n 和描述 d，执行工作的主体 b（对于叶子节点，是一个没有子主体的原始体；对于复合节点，则是由子 FAOP 组成的复合体），以及范围 Σ = ⟨ 𝒯 , 𝒢 ⟩ \Sigma=\langle\mathcal{T},\mathcal{G}\rangle。 在每个元组中，S_in 指定了 FAOP 读取的字段，而 S_out 指定了其生成的字段。 由于记录仅沿序列增长（约定 1），S_out 只列出 FAOP 添加的新字段；下一步看到的记录则是通过将这些新字段附加到输入状态中形成的。

paragraphs.en: The example artifact is a monthly account-statement workflow. It lists the steps needed to finish the task, the tools the agent may use, and the guardrails it must respect.
paragraphs.zh: 示例工件是一个月度账户对账单工作流程。 它列出了完成任务所需的步骤、智能体可能使用的工具，以及必须遵守的约束条件。

paragraphs.en: The steps are prose, the data each step needs is implicit, and nothing here is machine-checkable. The architect extracts this into a vocabulary and a registry (by hand, or with a model proposing a draft that the architect reviews and corrects).

paragraphs.en: The architect first resolves every name the AOP uses into a canonical vocabulary. Each entry carries a short description, so that two teams cannot register the same concept under different names (the client_id versus id_client drift of Section 2 ). Fields also carry a type.
paragraphs.zh: 架构师首先将 AOP 使用的每个名称解析为一个标准词汇表中的条目。 每个条目都附带一个简短描述，这样两个团队就无法用不同名称注册同一概念（即第 2 节中提到的 client_id 与 id_client 的偏差问题）。 字段也带有类型信息。

paragraphs.en: Every external step here goes through a tool; the executor never opens a database or a socket itself. So core_banking , ledger_svc , statement_store , and delivery_svc all carry the effect label op tool \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{tool}} , and summarizer carries op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} . Where each tool actually runs (an in-process function, a local MCP server, or a remote MCP endpoint) is a runtime binding chosen by the executor, not part of a FAOP’s type or scope.
paragraphs.zh: 此处的每个外部步骤都经过一个工具；执行器本身绝不会自行打开数据库或套接字。 因此，core_banking、ledger_svc、statement_store 和 delivery_svc 都带有效果标签 op tool \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{tool}}，而 summarizer 则带有 op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}}。 每个工具实际运行的位置（一个进程内函数、一个本地 MCP 服务器或一个远程 MCP 端点）是由执行器选择的运行时绑定，不属于 FAOP 的类型或范围。

paragraphs.en: Following the grammar mapping of Section 3.1 , the architect (writing the body directly or reviewing a translator model’s proposal) assigns each step a FAOP with its own id, and adds the root workflow issue_statement.v1 that sequences them; the branch of step 4 becomes an 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if} and the delivery of step 7 becomes a 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop} . Every FAOP declares its own scope, so the tool set 𝒯 \mathcal{T} differs from one entry to the next: FetchAccount.v1 lists only core_banking , while the root lists the union of the tools its children use. Guardrails propagate downward as a floor, so every FAOP carries no_sensitive_data_in_summary . Display convention: every reference to a registered FAOP is written as 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id}) , whether the target is an atomic leaf or a composite sub-workflow: a call is a call. The checkpoint primitive is written inline and is not a call; the delivery-preference interrupt is registered as AskDeliveryPreference.v1 and invoked like any other FAOP, so its prompt has one governed definition.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循第 3.1 节的语法映射，架构师（无论是直接编写主体还是审阅翻译模型的提案）为每个步骤分配一个带有唯一 ID 的 FAOP，并添加根工作流 issue_statement.v1 来对它们进行排序；步骤 4 的分支变成一个 𝑖𝑓 \mathit{if}，而步骤 7 的执行则变成一个 𝑙𝑜𝑜𝑝 \mathit{loop}。 每个 FAOP 都声明其自身的范围，因此工具集 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 在不同条目中各不相同：FetchAccount.v1 仅列出 core_banking，而根节点则列出了其子项所用工具的并集。 护栏向下传播形成一道底线，因此每个 FAOP 都携带 no_sensitive_data_in_summary。 显示约定：对已注册的 FAOP 的每次引用均写作 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑙 ⁡ ( id ) \mathit{call}(\text{id})，无论目标是一个原子叶节点还是一个复合子工作流：调用即调用。 检查点原语以内联方式编写，而非调用；交付偏好中断则注册为 AskDeliveryPreference.v1，并像其他任何 FAOP 一样被调用，因此其提示词只有一个受控定义。

paragraphs.en: Once the artifact is a vocabulary plus a registry of typed FAOP tuples, its structure is fixed before any code runs: name, meaning, body, dataflow contract, and per-FAOP scope are all declared.

paragraphs.en: The gain of this first transformation is integrity across the firm’s library , the first benefit of Table 5 :

paragraphs.en: From the vocabulary 𝒱 \mathcal{V} : every field, tool, and guardrail resolves to one canonical, described name shared by the whole library, so the same concept cannot drift into client_id in one workflow and id_client in another. This shared naming is the foundation of firm-wide consistency and integrity: workflows that mean the same thing now say it the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 在词汇表 𝒱 \mathcal{V} 中：每个字段、工具和护栏都对应一个由整个库共享的标准描述名称，因此同一概念不可能在一个工作流中变为 client_id，而在另一个工作流中变为 id_client。 这种共享的命名方式是实现全公司范围内一致性和完整性的基础：现在，含义相同的工作流也会以相同的方式表达。

paragraphs.en: The split is all that FNF-1 contributes here. Because the source AOP stores the statement once and then retries only its delivery, the one-time SaveStatement.v1 is additionally lifted out of the retry loop by a semantics-preserving reordering, leaving SendStatement.v1 as the loop body; the atomicity guarantee itself comes from the split.
paragraphs.zh: 这里的分割就是 FNF-1 所做的全部贡献。 由于源 AOP 仅存储一次该语句，然后只重试其发送，因此通过语义保留的重排序，将一次性的 SaveStatement.v1 从重试循环中进一步提取出来，使 SendStatement.v1 成为循环体；而原子性保证本身则来自该分割。

paragraphs.en: ComputeBalance.v1 needs no split: it reads statement_transactions and accrued_interest , writes ending_balance , and carries the effect label op compute \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{compute}} , a statically validated pure function of its inputs.
paragraphs.zh: ComputeBalance.v1 无需拆分：它读取 statement_transactions 和 accrued_interest，写入 ending_balance，并携带效果标签 op compute \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{compute}}，这是一个对其输入进行静态验证的纯函数。

paragraphs.en: Observability (from ℛ \mathcal{R} ): each leaf carries an id, schema, and effect label, so a trace identifies exactly which unit ran.
paragraphs.zh: 可观察性（来自 ℛ \mathcal{R}）：每个叶节点都携带一个 ID、模式和效果标签，因此一条轨迹可以精确识别出是哪个单元执行了操作。

paragraphs.en: Isolated testing (intrinsic): an atomic leaf is tested against its declared S_in / S_out without replaying the workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 孤立测试（内在）：在不重播工作流的情况下，对原子叶节点与其声明的 S_in / S_out 进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Failure localization and retry (intrinsic): a failure attaches to one named leaf rather than to an opaque paragraph.
paragraphs.zh: 故障定位与重试（内在）：故障会关联到一个有名称的叶节点，而不是一个不透明的段落。

paragraphs.en: LLM bypass (from the effect label): non- op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} leaves such as the two ledger_svc reads dispatch directly and deterministically, so only SummarizeActivity.v1 calls the model.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 绕过（来自效果标签）：非 op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} 会像两个 ledger_svc 读取一样直接且确定地分发，因此只有 SummarizeActivity.v1 会调用该模型。

paragraphs.en: Enabling: atomic, effect-labeled leaves are the precondition for FNF-2 to FNF-4 and for +O parallelization.
paragraphs.zh: 启用条件：具有原子性和效果标签的叶节点是 FNF-2 到 FNF-4 以及 +O 并行化的先决条件。

paragraphs.en: Type safety (from the compiler): the missing-field defect is caught before deployment instead of surfacing at runtime, where an agent would improvise the absent activity_summary .
paragraphs.zh: 类型安全性（来自编译器）：缺失字段缺陷在部署前就被捕获，而不是在运行时才暴露出来——否则智能体可能会随意处理缺失的 activity_summary。

paragraphs.en: Auto-parallelization (enabling, from the schemas in ℛ \mathcal{R} ): the same typed S_in / S_out contracts feed the independence test that +O later uses to run leaves concurrently.
paragraphs.zh: 自动并行化（启用，来自 ℛ \mathcal{R} 中的模式）：相同类型的 S_in / S_out 合约为独立性测试提供输入，而 +O 随后会利用该测试来并发执行叶子节点。

paragraphs.en: The firm’s library holds more than one statement workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 该公司的知识库中包含不止一个声明工作流程。

paragraphs.en: The FNF-3 decision procedure (Section 3.3 ) finds the repeated sub-tree by structural hashing and lists it as a candidate. Extraction is not automatic: the architect (optionally advised by a model, but making the final call) applies the composite policy Π comp \Pi_{\mathrm{comp}} , which weighs reuse count, domain meaning, ownership, and expected future reuse, and must not merge occurrences that only look alike. paragraphs.zh: 现在，每个调用者都会直接调用它，而不是重新构建子树：

paragraphs.en: Reuse without duplication (from ℛ \mathcal{R} ): the sub-procedure is defined once and called everywhere, so the copies can no longer drift apart.
paragraphs.zh: 无重复重用（来自 ℛ \mathcal{R}）：子程序只需定义一次，并在所有地方调用，因此各个副本不再可能发生偏差。

paragraphs.en: Single test and observability boundary (from ℛ \mathcal{R} ): the canonical composite has one identity, so it is tested and versioned in a single place, and its tracing and logging are configured once and standardized across the registry, so every invocation is observed the same way and every caller reuses the same governed unit.
paragraphs.zh: 单一测试与可观察性边界（来自 ℛ \mathcal{R}）：规范组合仅有一个身份，因此只需在单一位置进行测试和版本控制；其追踪和日志记录也只需配置一次，并在整个注册表中实现标准化，从而确保每次调用都以相同方式被观察，且每个调用者都能复用同一受控单元。

paragraphs.en: Integrity across workflows (from ℛ \mathcal{R} ): a change to the balance logic is made in one place, and the compiler rejects any dependent that becomes inconsistent with it.
paragraphs.zh: 跨工作流的一致性（来自 ℛ \mathcal{R}）：平衡逻辑在某个位置被修改后，编译器会拒绝任何与其不一致的依赖项。

paragraphs.en: Impact analysis (from ℛ \mathcal{R} ): the reverse-dependency index returns every workflow that calls the canonical FAOP.
paragraphs.zh: 影响分析（来自 ℛ \mathcal{R}）：反向依赖索引会返回所有调用标准 FAOP 的工作流。

paragraphs.en: Because each FAOP already declares its own scope, FNF-4 is a check, not a rewrite.
paragraphs.zh: 由于每个 FAOP 都已声明其自身的作用域，因此 FNF-4 是一项检查，而非重写。

paragraphs.en: Each FAOP carries a declared scope, but nothing yet guarantees that the scopes are consistent along the call tree: a child could name a tool its parent never granted, or a leaf could reach for a tool it did not declare. Until the check runs, the confinement is only an intention.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 FAOP 都携带一个声明的作用域，但目前没有任何机制能确保这些作用域在整个调用树中保持一致：子智能体可能会使用其父智能体从未授予的工具，或者叶节点可能会尝试使用它并未声明的工具。 在检查运行之前，这种限制只是一种意图。

paragraphs.en: Read as prose, the source AOP looks like an AI task: it is handed to an agent, and the reflex is to run the whole thing through a language model. Normalization shows that reflex to be wrong. Exactly one leaf carries the effect label op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} : SummarizeActivity.v1 . Every other leaf is a tool call, a value computation, an interrupt, or a checkpoint, and the only routing predicate, ending_balance < 0 , is an ordinary boolean over the state. This is why the level is λ = 1 \lambda=1 rather than something higher: the graph and routing are fixed and computable, and the model is used as a tool at a single point.
paragraphs.zh: 作为散文阅读，源 AOP 看起来像一项人工智能任务：它被交给一个智能体，而条件反射式的做法是将其全部内容输入语言模型。 归一化表明这种条件反射式的方法是错误的。 恰好有一个叶节点携带效果标签 op LLM \mathrm{op}_{\mathrm{LLM}} : SummarizeActivity.v1 。 所有其他叶节点都是工具调用、值计算、中断或检查点，而唯一的路由谓词 ending_balance < 0 是状态上的一个普通布尔值。 这就是为什么其层级为 λ = 1 \lambda=1 而非更高：图结构和路由是固定且可计算的，模型仅在单一点上作为工具使用。

paragraphs.en: The lesson runs against the habit of putting a language model in charge of everything. The statement is fetched, computed, stored, and delivered by deterministic steps that need no model, cost no tokens, and are fully reproducible; only the customer-facing prose genuinely calls for generation. Making that boundary explicit lets a firm reserve model spend, latency, and model-risk review for the one leaf that needs them and run the rest as a plain, auditable program. Replace that leaf with a templated summary and the workflow drops to λ = 0 \lambda=0 : no AI at all.
paragraphs.zh: 这一观点挑战了将语言模型置于一切事务核心位置的习惯做法。 该陈述通过确定性步骤获取、计算、存储和交付，这些步骤无需模型、不消耗令牌且完全可重复；只有面向客户的文本内容真正需要生成。 明确划分这一界限，使企业能将模型支出、延迟和模型风险评估专门保留给唯一需要它们的环节，其余部分则作为普通且可审计的程序运行。 若将该环节替换为模板化的摘要，整个工作流程的 λ 值将降至 0（λ = 0）：完全无需使用人工智能。

paragraphs.en: One normalized workflow is only the start. Suppose a second artifact arrives, an account_closure AOP that closes an account and issues a final statement. It is normalized against the same two stores: its steps resolve to the existing vocabulary, so it reads account_id and ending_balance rather than inventing acct_no or closing_bal , and FNF-3 makes it a caller of the registered FetchAccount.v1 and build_statement_facts.v1 rather than a fresh copy:
paragraphs.zh: 一个规范化的工作流程仅仅是个开始。 假设第二个工件到达，即一个 account_closure AOP，它会关闭账户并生成最终对账单。 它基于相同的两个存储进行规范化：其步骤会映射到现有词汇表，因此读取的是 account_id 和 ending_balance，而不是凭空创造 acct_no 或 closing_bal；并且 FNF-3 使其成为已注册的 FetchAccount.v1 和 build_statement_facts.v1 的调用者，而非一个新的副本：

paragraphs.en: Repeating this for every AOP in the firm (a large bank or insurer may run hundreds or even thousands of such workflows) turns a pile of independent workflows into one connected registry over one vocabulary. This is where the headline benefits of Table 5 appear at scale: one canonical definition per shared step (no drift), a reverse-dependency index that names every affected workflow (impact analysis), and a compiler that rejects any dependent a change would break (integrity across the whole library).
paragraphs.zh: 对组织中的每个 AOP 重复这一过程（一家大型银行或保险公司可能运行数百甚至数千个此类工作流），就能将一堆独立的工作流整合成一个基于统一词汇表的互联注册表。 此时，表 5 中列出的主要优势在大规模应用下便会显现：每个共享步骤都有唯一的规范定义（无偏差）、一个反向依赖索引可明确列出所有受影响的工作流（影响分析），以及一个编译器，能够拒绝任何可能破坏依赖关系的变更（整个库的完整性）。

paragraphs.en: A normalized FAOP is exported in either of the two forms of Section 4 :
paragraphs.zh: 标准化后的 FAOP 将以第 4 节中列出的两种形式之一导出：

paragraphs.en: Blueprint : the full form. A FAOP-aware executor materializes issue_statement.v1 into a runnable graph, binding core_banking , ledger_svc , statement_store , and delivery_svc , registering the interrupt and checkpoint handlers, and enforcing each leaf’s scope at run time. This form carries every guarantee, including runtime scope confinement and effect-based LLM bypass.
paragraphs.zh: 蓝图：完整形式。 一个具备 FAOP 意识的执行器将 issue_statement.v1 实例化为一个可运行的图，绑定 core_banking、ledger_svc、statement_store 和 delivery_svc，注册中断和检查点处理程序，并在运行时强制执行每个叶节点的域。 这种形式承载了所有保证，包括运行时域限制和基于效果的 LLM 绕过机制。

sents.zh: 蓝图：完整形式。

paragraphs.en: Adapted AOP : the degraded form. An adapter converts the same blueprint into an AOP in a target executor’s own format, so an existing framework can run it directly. It keeps the design-time structure (atomic typed steps, canonical reuse, and a clean description for discovery) and keeps the runtime guarantees, chiefly scope confinement and LLM bypass, to the extent that the target executor can enforce them.
paragraphs.zh: 适配型 AOP：退化形式。 适配器将相同的蓝图转换为目标执行器自身格式下的 AOP，这样现有的框架就可以直接运行它。 它在保持设计时结构（原子类型步骤、标准复用以及便于发现的清晰描述）的同时，也保留了运行时保障，尤其是作用域限制和绕过 LLM，只要目标执行器能够强制执行这些保障即可。

sents.zh: 适配型 AOP：退化形式。

sents.en: It keeps the design-time structure (atomic typed steps, canonical reuse, and a clean description for discovery) and keeps the runtime guarantees, chiefly scope confinement and LLM bypass, to the extent that the target executor can enforce them.
sents.zh: 它在保持设计时结构（原子类型步骤、标准复用以及便于发现的清晰描述）的同时，也保留了运行时保障，尤其是作用域限制和绕过 LLM，只要目标执行器能够强制执行这些保障即可。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, the adapted AOP is generated from the registry , not hand-maintained, so it inherits the library’s integrity: when a shared FAOP such as build_statement_facts.v1 changes, every adapted export that depends on it is regenerated from the same canonical source and stays consistent, instead of drifting the way a copy-pasted prompt would. The adapter path is therefore still useful because most agent frameworks today consume only their own AOP format: it is the backward-compatible path that runs a normalized workflow on an existing runtime without a rewrite, trading some runtime guarantees for immediate adoption while retaining design-time integrity.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，经过适配的 AOP 是从注册表中生成的，而非手动维护，因此它继承了库的完整性：当像 build_statement_facts.v1 这样的共享 FAOP 发生变化时，所有依赖它的适配导出项都会从同一个规范源重新生成并保持一致，而不会像复制粘贴的提示那样逐渐偏离。 因此，适配器路径仍然很有用，因为目前大多数智能体框架仅使用其自身的 AOP 格式：这是一条向后兼容的路径，无需重写即可在现有运行时执行标准化流程，以牺牲部分运行时保证为代价实现即时采用，同时保留设计时的完整性。
